Movement of Soviet Ambassador

Markham Road, will entertain representatives of local
public bodies to dinner in the Chinese Y.M.C.A. Restaurant,

has raised a sum of $4,500 from amongst Chinese women
for aviation construction purposes.

Nanking Road, has during the past two months raised a sum
of $□□,□□□.□□ from amongst local Ningpo natives for
aviation construction purposes.

REPORT
S.I, Special Branch
Date May 15, 1933.
Subject (in full) Further report on the execution of warrant
No.7972 issued in connection with the meeting held
in the restaurant of the Chinese Y.M.C.A. at 7.30 pm
on May 13 - particulars of attendance
Made by U.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Thos Robertson, Supt.

On Saturday, May 13, information was obtained that
a meeting sponsored by the People's Self Salvation
Association to Resist Insult under the guise of "The
Modern Dancing Society" was to be held in the restaurant
of the Chinese Y.M.C.A. at 7.30 p.m. that day. It was
also learned through Supt, Tan Shao-liang that the
Chinese authorities had been appraised of the projected
meeting and had applied for a warrant against 19 persons
who it was believed were to be present and who were
alleged to be connected with the Chinese Communist Party.
The object of the meeting was supposedly to discuss
ways and means of procuring the removal of seals from
No.75 San Yuen Li, Yangtsepoo Road, a branch office of
the People's Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult
which has been sealed by order the Shanghai Special District
Court for non-payment of rent.
The method to be adopted in future demonstrations,
etc. and the programme for the observance of the Anniversary
of May 30.
At 7.30 p.m. May 13, armed with the warrant applied
for by the Public Safety Bureau and assisted by
detectives from Central Station and accompanied by
representatives of the Public Safety Bureau the venue
of the meeting was visited.
Upon arrival it was found that the gathering was
taking the form of a dinner of which 89 persons were
partaking. This number consisted of 88 Chinese and
an American subject named Harold R. Isaacs, editor and
publisher of the China Forum, a political journal with

主题（全称） 关于执行与5月13日晚7时30分在中华基督教青年会餐厅举行的会议有关的第7972号逮捕令的进一步报告 - 出席者详情
由特别调查员 Golder 制作 经督察长 Thos Robertson 转发

5月13日星期六，获悉民众御侮自救会以“现代舞社”为名，将于当日晚7时30分在中华基督教青年会餐厅举行会议。另从谭绍良督察长处获悉，中国当局已获悉拟议中的会议，并申请对19人发出逮捕令，据信这些人将出席会议，且被指与中国共产党有关联。据称，会议的目的是讨论如何设法启封杨树浦路三元里75号（民众御侮自救会的一处办事处，因欠租被上海特区法院下令查封）的封条。
以及未来示威等活动将采取的方法，和纪念五卅周年的计划。
5月13日晚7时30分，警方持公安局申请的逮捕令，在中央巡捕房侦探的协助下，并由公安局代表陪同，前往会议地点。
到达后发现，聚会正以晚宴形式进行，共有89人参加。这些人包括88名中国人和一名美国籍人士 Harold R. Isaacs，他是《中国论坛》（China Forum）的编辑兼出版人，这是一份具有

REPORT
                               Date May 15, 1933.
Subject (in full) Execution of Warrant of arrest No.7972 issued by
                    Judge Dzien at the request of the Shanghai
                    Public Safety Bureau.
Made by D.S.I. Golder    Forwarded by Has Rubenstein, Supt.

The address contained in the attached
warrant was visited at 7.30 p.m. on Saturday, May 13,
by officers from Central Station and members of the
Special Branch. In the mezzanine floor of the
Chinese Y.M.C.A. which contains the restaurant, a
meeting sponsored by the People's Self Salvation
Association to Resist Insult was in progress, the
attendance consisting of 81 Chinese and one foreigner.
The particulars of those present were taken but none
of their names corresponded with those on the warrant.
The police left the premises at about 9.45 p.m.

Dan Golder
D. S. I.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

to Court. 16/5/33.

"A"
Central
Misc. 96/33.                      May    13,    33.

1.

Warrant of Arrest for 19 Communists.
-------
D.S.I. Golder of the Special Branch called at the
Central Station at 7 p.m. on 13-5-33 with a S.S.D. Court
Warrant for the arrest of 19 communists who were believed
to be attending a meeting in the Dining Room of the Chinese
Y.M.C.A., Szechuen Road. Assistance was rendered by
D.S.I. Rhind, C.D.S. 36 and C.D.C.s 16 and 260. When
the Dining Room of the Chinese Y.M.C.A. was entered
no less than 82 (64) persons were found therein sitting to
dinner with the well-known communist Earl Browder,
American citizen at the head of the table. He stated
that the meeting was not to be held. The names of all
persons present were noted but none was found to coincide
with the names mentioned on the warrant. After question-
ing, they were all allowed to leave whilst Earl Browder
left of his own accord, after waiting for about two hours
at his own desire. The names and particulars noted
have been retained by the Special Branch.

C. N/S.

特别支部特别调查员 Golder 于1933年5月13日晚7时携带最高法院签发的逮捕19名共产党分子的法庭逮捕令抵达中央巡捕房，据信这些人正在四川路中华基督教青年会餐厅参加会议。特别调查员 Rhind、刑事侦缉警士36号及刑事侦缉警员16号和260号提供了协助。进入中华基督教青年会餐厅后，发现不少于82（64）人在此用餐，著名共产党人、美国公民 Earl Browder 坐在主位。他声称会议并未举行。警方记录了所有在场人员的姓名，但未发现任何人与逮捕令上提到的名字相符。经讯问后，所有人均被允许离开，而 Earl Browder 则按其要求等待约两小时后自行离开。特别支部保留了记录的姓名及详情。

C. & S. B. REGISTRY.
No. D 4606
Date 5 / 5 / 33.

May 5, 1933. Morning Translation

MISCELLANEOUS

MAINICHI

MADAME SUN CONNECTED WITH REACTIONARIES

On May 1 the Shanghai Municipal Police raided the secret headquarters of the Anti-Japanese and National Salvation Association and seized a quantity of secret documents. Under the cloak of the Association, Chinese were engaged in reactionary activities.

As a result of the examination of the seized documents, it was discovered that Madame Sun is secretly connected with the Association and that she is also in touch with General Fang Tseng Wu, who has adopted a reactionary attitude towards the Nanking Government. General Fang reached a certain arrangement with Madame Sun when he recently visited Shanghai. He sent 10 members of the Association to the North to inquire into the health of soldiers at the front and they were subsequently attached to the army as plain clothes soldiers.

Towards the end of April, General Fang left for the North.

The Public Safety Bureau dispatched two members of its Special Branch to Madame Sun to make inquiries re the information obtained from the seized documents, but the Chinese detectives were turned away by Madame Sun.

Upon receiving a report from the detectives, Col. Wen, Chief of the Public Safety Bureau dispatched an officer to Nanking to submit a report and to ask for instructions.

INSPECTION OF JAPANESE GOODS IN NANKING ROAD SHOPS

At 9.30 a.m. May 3 the Nanking Road Street Union and the First Branch of the Shanghai Citizens Association dispatched members to inspect the shops on Nanking Road for Japanese goods.

Subsequently the inspectors turned in reports that no Japanese goods had been found but that strong suspicion was attached to a shop dealing in British goods. They further reported that two shops dealing in watches exhibited Japanese goods.

Certificates were immediately issued to those shops which had been found free of Japanese goods and the shops which had Japanese goods were warned to clear them away by a fixed date otherwise their names would be published in newspapers.

It was decided that in future inspectors be dispatched secretly and any shop found breaking the boycott will be deprived of its certificate.

INSPECTION OF JAPANESE SPECIAL LANDING FORCE

At 9 a.m. May 5 Rear-Admiral Sugiyama will inspect the Japanese Special Landing Force on a piece of ground in front of the Yufong Cotton Mill, Yangtsepoo.

1933年5月5日。晨间译件

杂项

《每日新闻》（MAINICHI）

宋庆龄女士与反动分子有牵连

5月1日，上海公共租界工部局警务处突袭了“抗日救国会”的秘密总部，并查获大量秘密文件。在该会的掩护下，华人从事反动活动。

经对查获文件的审查，发现宋庆龄女士与该会有秘密联系，并且她与方振武将军也有联络，方将军对南京政府持反动态度。方将军最近访问上海时，与宋庆龄女士达成某种安排。他派遣该会10名成员前往北方，名义上是慰问前线士兵的健康状况，随后这些人便以便衣士兵的身份被编入军队。

4月底，方将军前往北方。

公安局派遣两名特科人员向宋庆龄女士查询从查获文件中获得的情报，但中国侦探被宋庆龄女士拒之门外。

接到侦探的报告后，公安局局长温应星上校派员前往南京提交报告并请示指示。

检查南京路商店的日货

5月3日上午9时30分，南京路商界联合会和上海市民协会第一分会派遣成员检查南京路各商店是否有日货。

随后，检查人员提交报告称未发现日货，但对一家经营英货的商店存有强烈怀疑。他们还报告称，两家钟表店陈列有日货。

当局立即向未发现日货的商店颁发证书，并警告拥有日货的商店在限定日期前将其清除，否则将在报纸上公布其店名。

会议决定，今后将秘密派遣检查人员，任何被发现违反抵制运动的商店将被吊销证书。

检阅日本特别陆战队

5月5日上午9时，杉山海军少将将在杨树浦裕丰纱厂前的一块空地上检阅日本特别陆战队。

Date 3 / 5 / 33

May 3, 1933. Afternoon Translation.

COMMUNISM

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

THE PEOPLE'S SELF SALVATION ASSOCIATION TO RESIST INSULT.

After its inauguration, the People's Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult established its Eastern, Southern, Western and Northern Branches having the ostensible object of enabling people to participate freely in the anti-Japanese movement. As a matter of fact, those persons who are directing the affairs of this Association behind the screen are Communists. Some time ago, the Public Safety Bureau made a search of the premises of the general Association.
On May 1, under the name of the Shanghai Emergency Mass Meeting, the Association proposed to congregate Communists on the Public Recreation Ground, West Gate, with the intention of creating riots. Due to strict precautions in Chinese controlled territory, members of the Association rushed to the International Settlement where they held a meeting, distributed "Red" handbills and shouted Communist slogans. The Settlement Police arrested scores of them amongst whom were bona fide Communists, important members of the People's Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult.
The Municipality of Greater Shanghai has instructed the Public Safety Bureau to seal up the People's Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult and all its branches and to arrest the chief members of the Association.
The Settlement authorities have adopted drastic measures to deal with the Association.

Sin Wan Pao:

RATEPAYERS LETTER TO THE S.M.C.: EXPLANATION OF TORTURE TO EXTORT CONFESSION REQUESTED.

The Shanghai Chinese Ratepayers Association yesterday sent the following letter to the Secretary-General of the S.M.C.:-
"Lawyer Wu Liei has transferred the following letter from Lo Chi Chang, Lu Yang and others:-
'We were arrested on December 22, last year by the S.M.Police for conducting a patriotic movement. We were badly slashed and tortured with electricity, (the electric current was conducted through the temples of our heads and our genital organs). We swooned after being subjected of this torture, and we were brought to consciousness after being sprinkled with cold water for about ten minutes. Our bodies were just as if they were paralysed after we recovered consciousness and we felt excessive pains throughout our bodies which were the results of wounds. We request you to protest the matter for us'.
"Upon receiving the above letter, we discussed the matter at our 4th meeting. We then decided to request the Shanghai Bar Association and the People's Rights Protection League to uphold justice and demand the abolition of torture.
"As your Council is a civilised organisation, the allegation of torture might not be true, in our opinion. But should it be substantiated, this would indeed be a grievous case. Please give us an explanation in order to satisfy any doubts."

共产主义

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

民众御侮自救会将抵抗侮辱。

民众御侮自救会成立后，设立了东、南、西、北四个分会，其表面目的是让民众自由参与抗日运动。事实上，幕后指挥该会事务的人员是共产党人。此前，公安局搜查了该会总会的办公场所。
5月1日，该会以“上海紧急群众大会”的名义，提议在西门公共体育场聚集共产党人，意图制造骚乱。由于华界戒备森严，该会成员涌向公共租界，在那里举行集会，散发“红色”传单并高呼共产主义口号。租界巡捕逮捕了其中数十人，其中包括真正的共产党人以及民众御侮自救会的重要成员。
大上海市政府已指令公安局查封民众御侮自救会及其所有分会，并逮捕该会主要成员。
租界当局已采取严厉措施对付该会。

《新闻报》：

纳税人致工部局函：要求解释刑讯逼供一事。

上海华人纳税会昨日致函工部局总办，信件内容如下：-
吴雷律师转来罗吉昌、卢阳等人的一封信：-
‘我们去年12月22日因从事爱国运动被工部局警务处逮捕。我们遭到严重的刀砍和电刑折磨（电流通过我们的太阳穴和生殖器）。遭受这种酷刑后我们昏厥，大约十分钟后被冷水浇醒。苏醒后我们的身体如同瘫痪一般，全身感到剧烈疼痛，这是伤口造成的后果。我们请求你们为此事提出抗议’。
“收到上述信件后，我们在第四次会议上讨论了此事。随后决定请求上海律师公会和人权保障同盟主持公道，要求废除酷刑。
“鉴于贵董事会是一个文明机构，我们认为关于酷刑的指控可能不属实。但如果得到证实，这确实是一起严重的案件。请给予我们解释，以消除任何疑虑。”

May 2nd 1933

International Labour Day: May 1 - Demonstrations staged
by the People's Self Salvation Association to Resist
Insult - Arrests and seizure of communistic literature

This anniversary was taken advantage of by members
of the "People's Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult"
to stage demonstrations which, however, were effectively dispersed
by the Municipal Police and Chinese Authorities.
The fact that several members of the Association
arrested during a demonstration on Thornburn Road were in
possession of communistic literature while other participants
discarded in their flight bundles of leaflets of a like nature
is an indication that the Communist Party is behind the
Association or is utilizing its (the Association's) so-called
patriotic activity to further "red" propaganda.
The following is a resume of the demonstrations
referred to above together with particulars of raids carried
out on the various offices of the Association subsequent to the
seizure of communistic literature on Thorburn Road:-
Between 6 and 7.30 a.m. May 1 about 50 members
of the Eastern District Branch of the People's Self
Salvation Association to Resist Insult assembled in the
office at No.28 Seeng Mar Li, Sungpan Road, and at 7.40 a.m.
proceeded to a vacant piece of ground at the corner of Thor-
burn and Wayside Roads. On their arrival they were joined
by another party of 50 persons and a meeting was held, in
the course of which speeches were made, slogans shouted and
handbills bearing on the Anniversary in question distributed.
At 9 a.m. a party of Municipal Police arrived and dispersed
the gathering taking into custody 4 men and 3 women for obstruct-
ing and obstructing the police. Communist handbills were
found in the possession of a number of the persons arrested
while others discarded bundles of leaflets of the same nature.
At 20 a.m. about 80 members of the North District
Branch of the Association left their office at 168 Thiek
Li, Kiangsu Road, with the object of proceeding to the Public
Recreation Ground to attend a mass meeting which the
Association hoped to hold at 1 p.m. that day despite the
order of the Municipality prohibiting such gatherings. At
10.30 a.m. they came into collision with a party of Municipal
Police on North Kiangsu Road near Haining Road where some
of their number carrying banners and handbills issued by
the association and dealing on the Labour Day, were
apprehended. The remainder of the participants were dis-
persed without incident.
Twenty members of the Southern District Branch
of the Association left their office at 19 King Teh Road
off Avenue Joffre at 10.30 a.m. in order to proceed to
a rendezvous at Yuyuan Garden via Chapei district. On
arrival at the corner of Li Yuan Road they were met by a party
of Municipal Police who dispersed them and arrested

国际劳动节：5月1日——民众御侮自救会发起的示威活动——逮捕人员及缴获共产主义文献

民众御侮自救会的成员利用这一周年纪念日发动了示威活动，但被工部局警务处和华界当局有效驱散。
在通北路（Thornburn Road）的一次示威中被捕的几名该会成员身上携带有共产主义文献，而其他参与者在逃跑时丢弃了成捆的类似性质传单，这一事实表明共产党是该协会的幕后操纵者，或者正在利用该协会所谓的爱国活动来进一步推行“红色”宣传。
以下是上述示威活动的简述，以及在通北路缴获共产主义文献后对该协会各办事处进行搜查的详情：
5月1日上午6时至7时30分，民众御侮自救会东区分会的约50名成员聚集在松潘路（Sungpan Road）圣马里（Seeng Mar Li，音译）28号的办事处，并于上午7时40分前往通北路与汇山路（Wayside Road）拐角处的一块空地。他们到达后，另一拨50人加入其中并举行了会议，期间发表了演说，高喊口号，并散发了有关该周年纪念日的传单。上午9时，一组工部局警察赶到并驱散了集会，以妨碍警察办公为由拘留了4名男子和3名女子。在多名被捕者身上发现了共产主义传单，而其他人则丢弃了成捆的同类传单。
上午10时，该协会北区分会的约80名成员离开他们位于江苏路（Kiangsu Road）德里（Thiek Li，音译）168号的办事处，意图前往公共体育场参加该协会希望在当天下午1时举行的群众大会，尽管市政当局已下令禁止此类集会。上午10时30分，他们在北江苏路（North Kiangsu Road）靠近海宁路（Haining Road）处与一组工部局警察发生冲突，其中一些携带该协会发布的关于劳动节的旗帜和传单的人员被捕。其余参与者被驱散，未发生进一步事件。
该协会南区分会的20名成员于上午10时30分离开他们位于霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）附近的景德路（King Teh Road）19号的办事处，以便经由闸北区前往豫园（Yuyuan Garden）的集合点。到达丽园路（Li Yuan Road）拐角处时，他们遇到了一组工部局警察，警察驱散了他们并逮捕了

The remainder of the party then made its way in small
groups towards the corner of Thibet and Avenue Roads
where they were joined by about 30 persons of the student
and worker classes who had made their appearance in
isolated groups at about 10.40 a.m. on Thibet Road near

Banners and sticks were observed being carried by the

as well as those of an anti-Kuomintang nature, whereupon
the police intervened and dispersed them, taking six of
their number into custody. One of the persons apprehended
was later found to be a Formosan wanted for subversive
activities in Formosa and accordingly handed over to the
Japanese Consular Authorities.
Shortly after 12 noon members of the various
branches commenced to gather in the Head Office at 15

to protest against the arrest of members of the body by
the Municipal Police. At 12.30 p.m. before the meeting
was under way Municipal Police acting on information

1933年4月29日下午6时20分，华捕148号在靠近平凉路（Pingliang Road）的眉州路（Meichow Road）上逮捕了以下三名中国男子，当时他们正持有84份传单并正在墙上张贴。

这些传单性质相似，主要提醒人们参加将于1933年5月1日下午1时在老西门公共体育场举行的“市民紧急大会”，以抗议日本帝国主义侵略华北，并哀悼北方抗日阵亡将士等。

这些小册子的译文随附于此。

1933年4月29日晚上8时，该协会的两名代表：(1) 王维进 (Wang Vee Tsing)，27岁，南京人，北四川路公园坊21号文华（原文不清）学院教师；(2) 陆庆虎 (Loh Ching Fu)，24岁，江苏泰兴人，杨树浦路申新九厂加油工，居住在杨树浦路依仁里（Ye Zung Li）82号；他们带了一封信来到捕房，说明上述3名被捕男子是该协会成员，并受命在杨树浦区张贴爱国广告。因此，这些代表被详细询问以核实身份，以消除任何误解并请求释放被捕者。

Subject (in full) Activities of the People's Self Salvation Association
to Resist Insult.

Made by D. S. MacAdie Forwarded by Tho Rubentam, Supt

The Head Office of the Association removed to
No.15 I Yoen Li (怡安里), Carter Road (Sinza District)
on April 29 and not to 15 Carter Li, Carter Road, as
reported yesterday.

The Central District Branch Office of the
People's Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult
will hold an inaugural meeting at 10 a.m. April 30 in the
office of the Southern District Branch Office, 19 Ming
Teh Li, Avenue Joffre. This new branch office has no
address yet.

Owing to the arrangements being incomplete,
the plan of the Head Office of the People's Self Salvation
Association to Resist Insult to entertain representatives
of local factories in the Chinese Y.M.C.A. Restaurant,
201 Szechuen Road, at 7 p.m. April 28, did not take place.

At 5.15 p.m. April 28, two Chinese including
Chang Ling of the Propaganda Section of the Southern District
Branch called at the Kiu Sing Theatre, 359 Avenue Foch and
attempted to deliver lectures to the attendance on the
propaganda of the Association. They were refused admission
by the management who stated that permission could only
be granted on instruction from the Police. Consequently
the callers left copies of three different handbills
bearing on the inauguration and regulation of the body as
well as the volunteer corps, copies of which have already
been translated and forwarded, with the management and departed.

（批：SI, Please include items of special interest in summarized form in Daily Report and Chief Supt. May 1/5. 33）

R. W. Mac Adie.
Officer i/c Special Branch.
APR 29 1933

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. REGISTRY
N. D. H 606

Subject (in full) Activities of the People's Self Salvation
Association to Resist Insult

Made by D.S. MacAdie Forwarded by The Robertson, Supt.

The above Association has decided to send seven open
air lecturing groups of three persons each to deliver
propaganda speeches to the public on April 28 in Nantao and
City as well as at the Kiu Sing Theatre, Avenue Foch.

Arrangements have been made for the preparation of
banners and scrolls, large cloth cartoons, advertisements,
pictorials, 600 posters, 500 bearing slogans and 3,000 copies
of a manifesto for use and distribution at the Mass Meeting
scheduled for May 1 on the Public Recreation Ground, West
Gate. In addition 20 slogan shouting groups and 20 handbill
distributing groups have been formed and will function at
the meeting in question as well as enlisting groups, fund
soliciting groups and inspecting groups. A picketing group
of 100 persons consisting chiefly of seamen and students has
been organized for duty at the Mass gathering. Members of
the Eastern District Branch are engaged in devising measures
to oppose the five day working week, adopted by many factories
in Shanghai due to trade depression, which will include the
picketing of industrial plants, warning employers, demonstrating
in the offices of factory managements and finally the
declaration of a general strike.

The Shanghai Municipality Branch of Association has
organized a "Shanghai People's Automatically Purchasing
Anti-Japanese Aeroplane Committee" and a "Labourers' Anti-
Japanese Movement Committee".

Four men claiming to represent the People's Self
Salvation Association to Resist Insult called at the Shanghai
Duck Slaughter House Workers' Union, 59 Tsih Zuan Zu Loong,
City, on April 26 and acted roughly in exacting $10 from the

Translation of a leaflet entitled "A manifesto calling
for an urgent mass meeting to oppose the attack on
North China by the Japanese imperialists and to
commemorate the deceased warriors.

------

Dear people of the whole district,

We should commemorate the "May 1" festival on
which occasion, the toiling masses secured freedom and
emancipation. We should take part with our iron
spirit in the urgent mass meeting to oppose the attack
on North China and to commemorate the deceased warriors.
We should struggle for absolute freedom in speech,
assemblage, organization, publication ..... We should
also intensify the boycott movement. Only by our own
power, can we save the nation from ruin and give a "reply"
to the imperialists and the non-resistance policy.
Citizens, take part in the May 1 mass meeting unanimously.

Shanghai Western District Branch of
the People's Self Salvation Association
to Resist insult.

Chopped : Propaganda Department of the
People's Self Salvation Association
to Resist insult.

题为《号召召开紧急群众大会以反对日本帝国主义进攻华北并纪念阵亡将士宣言》的传单译文。

全区同胞们：

我们应当纪念“五一”节，这是劳动大众获得自由和解放的节日。我们要以钢铁般的精神，参加反对进攻华北和纪念阵亡将士的紧急群众大会。我们要争取言论、集会、结社、出版……的绝对自由。我们还应加强抵制运动。只有依靠我们自己的力量，才能挽救国家于危亡，并对帝国主义和不抵抗政策给予“回击”。
市民们，一致参加五一群众大会。

民众救国抗侮会上海西区分会。

page_data.en:
Translation of a pamphlet entitled "A letter to
people in business circles in connection with
inspection of Japanese Goods," purporting to
emanate from the Japanese Goods Inspection
Committee of the Southern Branch Office
------------

Dear Brethren :

While the imperialists are attempting to partition
China, the Japanese imperialists have attacked and
occupied the whole of the North East. The Chinese
nation is on the point of death. In order to save the
nation and overthrow the Imperialists, we should
unite closely together.

While the soldiers at the front are fighting
a bloody battle with the Japanese imperialists, what
shall we do at the rear to support them. Business
Brethren : Most of you are patriotic, but there is
still a great number of you who are dealing in
Japanese goods though these people proclaim that
they will never deal in Japanese products. These
traitorous merchants have forgotten that they are
citizens of China but seem rather to be the offspring
of the Japanese. You should understand that the more
Japanese goods you purchase, the more money the Japanese
will have to buy ammunition to kill us.

You merchants should refuse to deal in Japanese
goods and oppose the partitioning of China by the
Imperialists.

Seal of the Japanese Goods Inspection
Committee of the People's Self Salvation
Association to Resist Insult. (Southern
Branch Office).

April 27,

题为《致商界同仁关于检查日货的信》的小册子译文，据称出自南区办事处的日货检查委员会
------------

各位同仁：

当帝国主义企图瓜分中国之际，日本帝国主义已攻占整个东北。中华民族已处于生死存亡之秋。为了救国和推翻帝国主义，我们必须紧密团结。

当前线士兵与日本帝国主义进行浴血奋战时，我们在后方应如何支持他们。商界同仁们：你们大多具有爱国心，但仍有许多人虽然宣称绝不经营日货，却在暗中交易。这些奸商忘记了自己是中华民国公民，反而像是日本人的后裔。你们应当明白，你们购买日货越多，日本人就有越多的资金购买弹药来杀害我们。

你们商人应拒绝经营日货，反对帝国主义瓜分中国。

民众救国抗侮会日货检查委员会印章。（南区办事处）。

4月27日，

Subject (in full) Result of watch kept on certain persons who participated in the demonstration held at the Customs Jetty on April 23,1933,to welcome the arrival of D.V.Bogomoloff,Soviet Ambassador to China.

Made by D.I.Kuh Pao-hwa Forwarded by Q.B.Ru. S.I.

C.D.S.155 reports that acting upon the orders of
D.S.I.Duncan,he instructed an agent to shadow the male Chinese
who presided over the gathering at the Customs Jetty on the
afternoon of April 23, 1933, to welcome D.V. Bogomoloff, Soviet
Ambassador to China. The individual was shadowed to Love Lane
off B'Well Road where he was eventually lost sight of.
However, as a result of a watch kept in this neighbourhood, the
man in question was seen to enter the back door of house
No.19 Tien Loh Faung (天樂坊), Love Lane off B'Well Road, at
5.40 p.m. on April 25. On this occasion he was observed to
be in the company of another male Chinese whose description
is as follows :-
Age about 20, height about 5'3", dark complexion,
medium build, wearing a light grey long gown and black foreign
trousers (this individual also participated in the demonstration
at the Customs Jetty on the afternoon of 23.4.33).

A female Chinese, who also participated in the
welcome, was later shadowed by C.D.S.155 to No.28 Soong Meu Li
(宋美里), Sungpan Road, on April 23, an office of the "People's
Self-Salvation Association to Resist Insult" (國民禦侮自救會).
She was again observed visiting this address at 1.40 p.m.
April 24 where she remained until 6 p.m.,which would indicate
that she is attached to the "People's Self-Salvation Association
to Resist Insult". This woman was also shadowed to No.39 Yu
Ching Li (餘慶里), East Yuhang Road, at 7 p.m. April 24 where
she entered by the back door. It appears that she resides
at this address and occupies the downstairs back room (kitchen
room).
Officer i/c Special Branch. Kuh Pao-hwa
D.I.

刑事侦缉处第155号探员报告称，奉副警司邓肯（D.S.I. Duncan）之命，他指示一名密探跟踪1933年4月23日下午在海关码头主持欢迎苏联驻华大使D.V.博戈莫洛夫集会的那名中国男子。该人被跟踪至倍开尔路（B'Well Road）旁的乐安里（Love Lane），最终失去踪迹。然而，由于在该地区进行了监视，于4月25日下午5时40分，目睹该男子进入倍开尔路旁乐安里天乐坊19号的后门。当时观察到他与另一名中国男子在一起，后者特征如下：
年龄约20岁，身高约5英尺3英寸，肤色黝黑，中等身材，身穿浅灰色长衫和黑色西式长裤（此人也参与了1933年4月23日下午在海关码头的示威活动）。

page_data.en:
Summary translation of a handbill entitled "Special issue
to Welcome Soviet-Ambassador" dated April 25 and published
by the Southern District Branch of the People's Self
Salvation Association to Resist Insult, 19 King Teh Li,
Avenue Joffre

On learning that the Soviet-Ambassador, Bogomoloff
will arrive at Shanghai, this Association planned to call
upon the Shanghai citizens to welcome the Angel of Peace.
Owing to lack of time and funds, we could not entertain
him as the Chinese of the higher class entertained the
League Commission. We welcomed him only by shouting
slogans, firing crackers and holding a procession. The
following are details of the welcome extended to the
Ambassador :

At about 2 p.m. this date, some 300 members of this
Association carrying flags proceeded to the Customs Wharf
and people from other districts came later on, when a
welcoming meeting was held and the following resolutions
were passed :-

1. That a telegram be despatched to Moscow in connection
with the welcome of the Soviet Ambassador.

2. That a "San You Zoe" of Soviet-Russia be organized in
order to accelerate the union of the peoples of Soviet
and China.

3. That an exhibition be prepared to celebrate the success
of the "Soviet five year plan" and to introduce the success
of Soviet-construction into China.

Just at this time, the steamer with the Ambassador on board,
arrived at the wharf when slogans were shouted and crackers
fired. The meeting broke up after the Ambassador left the
wharf.

Then an Anti-Japanese and anti-imperialists procession
was held along the Bund and Avenue Edward VII; slogans were
shouted while proceeding. The police attempted to prevent
us but in spite of this a female participant delivered a
speech among the crowd saying that "We should oppose the
page_data.zh:
题为《欢迎苏联大使特刊》的传单译文摘要，该传单日期为4月25日，由国民御侮自救会南区分会出版，地址为霞飞路金德里19号

获悉苏联大使博戈莫洛夫将抵达上海，本会计划号召上海市民欢迎这位和平天使。由于时间和资金不足，我们无法像上层阶级中国人招待国联调查团那样款待他。我们仅通过呼喊口号、燃放鞭炮和举行游行来欢迎他。以下是向大使表示欢迎的详细情况：

当日下午2时许，本会约300名会员携带旗帜前往海关码头，随后其他各区民众也陆续到来，举行了欢迎大会，并通过以下决议：

1. 就欢迎苏联大使一事，向莫斯科发送电报。

2. 组织苏俄“三友社”，以加速苏中两国人民的联合。

3. 筹备展览，庆祝“苏联五年计划”的成功，并将苏联建设的成就介绍到中国。

就在此时，载有大使的轮船抵达码头，现场高呼口号并燃放鞭炮。大使离开码头后，集会解散。

随后，沿外滩和爱德华七世大道举行了抗日反帝游行；行进过程中高呼口号。警方试图阻止我们，尽管如此，一名女性参与者在人群中发表演讲，称“我们应该反对

page_data.en:
Japanese and imperialists and other oppressors, etc"
The procession then broke up.

While the imperialists are attempting to interfere
with the Soviet and the Japanese attempting to invade
north china, we should unite strongly with the Soviet
in order to attain "real peace" and to reveal the intrigue
of the "robbers". We should shoute the following
slogans :-

1. Let china and Soviet-Russia unite together in order to
oppose the Japanese imperialists.

2. Let china and Soviet-Russia unite together in order to
oppose varicus Imperialists.

Every body knows that the Soviet is a socialist
nation. It cancelled all unequal treaties with china.
It accommodated our escaping volunteers and relieved
the Norther Eastern sufferers. Therefore the Soviet is
our intimate friend.

The arrival of the Soviet Ambassador in China means
that the two countries will unite together to oppose the
invasion of Soviet Russia and the partitioning of China
by the Imperialists.

The success of Soviet construction shortens
the life of the imperialists and is the victory of all
weak and small nations.

In order to maintain the intimate relations between
Soviet and China and strengthen the power to oppose the
Imperialists we should welcome the Soviet Ambassador.
page_data.zh:
日本人和帝国主义者及其他压迫者等”
随后游行队伍解散。

当帝国主义者试图干涉苏联，而日本人试图入侵华北时，我们应该与苏联紧密团结，以实现“真正的和平”，并揭露“强盗”的阴谋。我们应该高呼以下口号：

1. 中苏联合起来，反对日本帝国主义者。

2. 中苏联合起来，反对各种帝国主义者。

众所周知，苏联是一个社会主义国家。它废除了与中国的所有不平等条约。它收容了我们逃亡的义勇军，并救济了东北受灾民众。因此，苏联是我们的亲密朋友。

苏联大使抵达中国，意味着两国将联合起来，反对帝国主义对苏联的入侵和对中国的瓜分。

苏联建设的成功缩短了帝国主义者的寿命，是所有弱小民族的胜利。

为了维持苏中之间的亲密关系并加强反对帝国主义的力量，我们应该欢迎苏联大使。

Wall Paper Issue no.1, purporting to be compiled by the
Propaganda Department of the People's Self Salvation
Association to Resist Insult. The paper is dated 25/4/33.

(a) The whole body of armed people to proceed to the
north and resist Japan.

-- let all the people in Shanghai rise and join
the "Volunteer Groups to Proceed to the north"
of the People's Self Salvation Association to
Resist insult. --

The Japanese imperialists have within a short time
occupied various passes of the Great Wall and are pressing
upon Peiping and Tientsin: The fault lies with the
Government Authorities for not assisting the North Eastern
Volunteer Armies, in addition to the firearms of the
Japanese imperialists. The Government forces are retreating
on the ground of "strategy" and swear to hold the non-
resistance policy in order to abandon the national territory
and sell the lives and property of the people. The
Government Authorities, however, are extraordinarily
enthusiastic in the civil strife to cruelly kill the brethren.
They have mobilized all available men and aeroplanes in
this campaign. Chiang Kai-shek has declared that he will
not resist Japan but swears to die in the civil strife
to kill the people. The people of the whole nation while
they are being attacked both from within and without, must
break through and form a bloody road to the north to kill
the enemy.

Rise, let the people of the nation arm themselves, demand
that the Government issue arms and ammunition, join the
"Volunteer Groups to Proceed to the North" of the People's
Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult and meanwhile
steadfastly demand that the Government should despatch all
its forces and aeroplanes to accompany us to proceed to the
North.

《墙报》第1期，声称由国民御侮自救会宣传部编纂。报纸日期为1933年4月25日。

(a) 全体武装人员北上抗日。

-- 让上海全体人民行动起来，加入国民御侮自救会的“北上义勇队”。 --

日本帝国主义者在短时间内占领了长城各关口，并逼近北平和天津：过错在于政府当局未协助东北义勇军，加之日本帝国主义者的枪炮威力。政府军队以“战略”为借口撤退，并誓言坚持不抵抗政策，以便放弃国土，出卖人民的生命财产。然而，政府当局在内战中异常狂热，残酷地屠杀同胞。他们在这场战役中动员了所有可用的人员和飞机。蒋介石已宣布他不抵抗日本，但发誓要在内战中死去以杀戮人民。全国人民在遭受内外夹击之际，必须突围而出，杀出一条血路北上去杀敌。

起来，让全国人民武装起来，要求政府发放武器弹药，加入国民御侮自救会的“北上义勇队”，同时坚定要求政府派遣其全部军队和飞机陪同我们北上。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

(b) The reason for welcoming the Soviet Ambassador
--------

We are not welcoming the person of the Soviet Ambassador,
but the Sino-Soviet peace policy brought here by the minister.
The Soviet Government opposes the imperialists, the
colonization and the oppression and invasion of weak and
small races. We also oppose the oppression and invasion
on the part of the imperialists and thus we can maintain the
integrity of territorial rights and independence of the
nation. Therefore, the people of China and Soviet Russia
should closely unite on the abovementioned standing of the
two countries. This is considerably different from the
welcome extended by the great men to the Enquiry Commission
of the League of Nations which plotted to harm China.
On the 23rd, the Soviet Ambassador arrived at Shanghai.
This association assigned representatives and summoned
some 20 people, who formed a procession and shouted slogans,
welcoming the ambassador. On the 24th, the association again
sent some 10 representatives of various district branches to
the residence of the ambassador, where they interviewed him
and gave him a written eulogy as well as important documents
of this association, i.e. dealing with the sympathy of
Soviet Russia for the weak and small races and the assistance
it is able to give the Chinese race as well as pointing
out that it should for these reasons come to a close understand-
ing with this association.

（批：Only one man was admitted to the Embassy & he was inside but a few minutes M）
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

(b) 欢迎苏联大使的原因
--------

我们欢迎的不是苏联大使这个人，而是部长带来的中苏和平政策。苏联政府反对帝国主义者，反对对弱小民族的殖民、压迫和入侵。我们也反对帝国主义者的压迫和入侵，从而我们可以维护领土主权的完整和国家的独立。因此，基于上述两国的立场，中国和苏联人民应该紧密团结。这与大人物们欢迎旨在损害中国的国联调查团有着显著不同。
23日，苏联大使抵达上海。本会指派代表并召集约20人，组成游行队伍，高呼口号，欢迎大使。24日，本会再次派遣各区分会的约10名代表前往大使寓所，在那里会见了他，并向他递交了一份书面颂词以及本会的重要文件，即涉及苏联对弱小民族的同情及其能给予中华民族的援助，并指出基于这些原因，应与本会达成密切谅解。

（批注：仅一人获准进入大使馆，且仅在内部停留了几分钟 M）

Translation of cartoons entitled "Anti-insult Pictorial"
issue No.3 dated April 25 and purporting to emanate from
the Southern branch of the People's Self Salvation
Association to Resist insult
------------------

This pictorial contains four cartoons :-

1) Depicting a group of people surrounding a man shouting :
"Brethren: If you want to save yourselves, you
should join quickly the People's Self Salvation
Association to Resist Insult!"

2) Depicting a group of people at a wharf carrying flags
bearing inscriptions "Welcome the Soviet Ambassador
to China", "Welcome the Prince of Peace, the Soviet
Ambassador to China".

3) Showing a mass meeting in progress with flags bearing
inscriptions "Protect the People's Rights and Release
all Political Offenders", "Take part in the mass
meeting" and "Mass meeting", and headed "A mass meeting
to oppose the invasion of the Japanese-Imperialists in
North China and to commemorate the martyrs of the anti-
Japanese campaign."

4) Showing a number of soldiers armed with rifles, marching
and inscribed "Organize volunteer troops to proceed to
the North and protest the Northern Territory of our own
accord".

题为《抗辱画报》第3期的漫画译文，出版日期为4月25日，声称出自“人民自救抗辱会”南区分会
------------------

该画报包含四幅漫画：

1) 描绘一群人围住一名男子高喊：“同胞们！若要自救，应迅速加入人民自救抗辱会！”

2) 描绘一群人在码头，手持写有“欢迎苏联大使来华”、“欢迎和平王子、苏联驻华大使”字样的旗帜。

3) 显示正在进行的群众大会，旗帜上写有“保障民权，释放所有政治犯”、“参加群众大会”和“群众大会”，标题为“反对日本帝国主义侵略华北及纪念抗日烈士群众大会”。

4) 显示数名士兵持步枪行进，配文“自动组织志愿军北上抗议北方领土丧失”。

page_data.en:
Synopsis of a modern drama by the "Spring & Autumn
Dramatic Association.
------------------

The play concerns a family living in the vicinity of
the Chinese Eastern Railway. Members of this family at
the commencement describe the killing of Chinese civilians
including infants, xxxxxxx with knives and the burying
of Chinese alive. The drama then depicts the return of
the eldest son of the family who was sold to another man
about ten years ago. The eldest son tells his mother
that he served in the army in which he together with other
poor fellows fought under leaders who were at war for the
sake of their power. He also remarks that when the
Japanese cruelly killed the civilians, the leaders who
struggled for power not only did not fight against invasion
but surrendered to the enemies. The drama concludes with
the victory secured by the volunteers, which causes the
dying mother of the play to smile for the last time.
page_data.zh:
“春秋剧社”现代剧剧情概要
------------------

该剧讲述了一个居住在中东铁路附近的家庭的故事。剧初，家庭成员描述了包括婴儿在内的中国平民被刀杀害（原文不清）以及中国人被活埋的情景。随后，剧情描绘了大约十年前被卖给他人的长子归来。长子告诉母亲，他在军队服役，与其他穷苦兄弟一起在为首领争夺权力而战的领导下作战。他还指出，当日本人残酷杀害平民时，那些争权夺利的首领不仅没有抵抗入侵，反而向敌人投降。剧集终以志愿军取得胜利告终，这使得剧中垂死的母亲最后一次露出了微笑。

Translation of a handbill entitled "A manifesto of the
representative meeting of the Southern District branch
of the People's Self Salvation Association to Resist
insult, calling upon the Shanghai citizens to attend
a mass meeting to oppose the attack on North China
by the Japanese.

----------

The North Eastern Territory has been lost for a
period of 20 months. In order to take away the troops
and land of Chang Hsueh-liang, Chiang K i-shek has
himself proceeded to the north. Various militarists in
China are not assisting each other. Not a soldier nor
a round of ammunition has been sent to assist the
soldiers at the front. Consequently the troops of Sung
Tsih-yuan and Sung Dien-ying were dissolved following
the loss of Luan-tung. During this dangerous moment
Chiang Kai-shek concentrates his troops in the interior
for the purpose of killing our brethren in order to
consummate his opinion "it is necessary to subdue
the interior prior to the resistance of external
invasion". From this point of view, the Government
cannot screen its plan of "direct negotiation".
Brethren ! The militarists will never despatch
their troops to resist the Japanese. Only the people
can arm ourselves and organise volunteer troops to proceed
to the North to fight with the Japanese . In this way,
the lost territory will be restored, and Chinese territory
will be protected. With a view to uniting the Shanghai
citizens, resisting invasion in North China by the Japanese
Imperialists and commemorating the martyrs at the front,
the People's Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult
has decided to convene an urgent mass meeting of people
in various walks of life. The District Representative
Meeting is of the opinion that the holding of a mass meeting
is of the utmost importance. Consequently this
page_data.zh:

东北领土已沦陷20个月。为了夺取张学良的军队和土地，蒋介石亲自北上。中国各路军阀互不援助。没有一兵一卒或一弹一药被派往前线支援士兵。因此，宋哲元和宋殿英的部队在滦东失守后被解散。在这危急时刻，蒋介石将部队集中在内地，旨在杀害我们的同胞，以实现其“攘外必先安内”的主张。从这个角度来看，政府无法掩盖其“直接谈判”的计划。
同胞们！军阀永远不会派兵抗日。只有人民才能武装自己，组织志愿军北上与日本人作战。只有这样，失地才能收复，中国领土才能得到保护。为了团结上海市民，抵抗日本帝国主义对华北的入侵，并纪念前线烈士，人民自救会抗辱分会决定召开各界群众紧急大会。区代表会议认为召开大会至关重要。因此，本

Translation of a notice issued by the People's Self
Salvation Association to Resist insult, dated April 25, and
obtained from the Southern Branch Office.
------------
To various bodies, schools, and newspaper offices,
Recently the Japanese troops passed the Great
Wall and are now going to attack Peiping and Tientsin.
Various places at Luan-tung fell into their hands one after
another. The life of the nation is hanging by a thread, and
various imperialists are continuing their plan to partition
China and convene the Washington Conference with a view to
colonizing China. Our Government does not resist aggression
from without but kills its people from within, and from the
point of view of diplomacy, it unites with foreign nations
in order to stabilize the dictatorship. It pays no
attention to the loss of millions of lives and vast
stretches of land in the North. For this reason we should
rise up and resist insult of our own accord. A mass meeting
of Shanghai citizens will be held on May 1 to commemorate the
soldiers sacrificed for the nation and to oppose the invasion
of North China by the Japanese Imperialists. We beg to
request you to rise up and save the life of our nation.

Preparatory Committee to hold a mass
meeting to oppose the Japanese
Imperialists' Invasion of North China and
to Commemorate the martyrs.

April 25.

Resist Insult, Shanghai.

近日日军越过长城，现正企图进攻北平和天津。滦东各地相继落入他们手中。国家命悬一线，各帝国主义列强继续推行瓜分中国的计划，并召开华盛顿会议，旨在殖民中国。我国政府对外不抵抗侵略，对内却屠杀人民，从外交角度看，它与外国勾结以稳固独裁统治。它对北方数百万生命的丧失和广袤土地的丢失置若罔闻。因此，我们应该自发起来抗辱。上海市民大会将于5月1日举行，以纪念为国捐躯的士兵，并反对日本帝国主义对华北的入侵。我们恳请贵方奋起，挽救我国的生命。

calling for an urgent mass meeting to oppose the
attack made by the Japanese imperialists on North
China and to commemorate the deceased Warriors"

People of the whole district :

Rise and take part in the urgent mass meeting to
oppose the attack made by the Japanese Imperialists on
North China and to commemorate the deceased warriors !

The forces of the Japanese Imperialists have
occupied various passes of the Great Wall; and Peiping,
Tientsin and North China are in danger.

The North Eastern Masses have risen to save themselves
and suffered terribly, while the people of the whole nation have
been assisting them and are exhausted. The Government, however,
is still unwilling to resist Japan, and volunteers have been
killed or disarmed and patriotic organizations suppressed.
Troops are mobilized towards the south and arms are pointed
towards the "interior", cruelly killing the brethren. The
Japanese will attack Peiping and Tientsin in order to make the
non-resistance government surrender to "Hwa Pei Kuo" (North
China Nation) "Neutral Zone" etc. With a view to carrying
out their plan, the Japanese will undoubtedly oppress the
Chinese anti-Japanese and anti-Imperialist movements as their
first step; and as a preliminary they will attack the Chinese
masses.

The activities of the Government are contrary to the
opinions of the masses, while the enemy is pressing North
China step by step. Should North China be internationally
controlled, the greater part of the country will be ruined.
Shanghai is the important base of the International
Imperialists to invade China and also a place in which the
page_data.zh:

全区民众：

起来参加紧急大会，反对日本帝国主义对华北的进攻，并纪念阵亡将士！

日本帝国主义的军队已占领长城各关口；北平、天津和华北危在旦夕。

东北民众奋起自救，遭受了惨重的苦难，而全国人民一直在援助他们，并已精疲力竭。然而，政府仍不愿抗日，志愿军被杀害或解除武装，爱国组织遭到镇压。部队向南调动，枪口指向“内部”，残酷地杀害同胞。日本人将进攻北平和天津，迫使不抵抗政府屈服于“华北国”、“中立区”等。为了实施其计划，日本人无疑会将压制中国的抗日和反帝运动作为第一步；作为前奏，他们将攻击中国民众。

政府的活动违背了民众的意愿，而敌人正一步步逼近华北。如果华北受到国际管制，该国大部分地区将遭到毁灭。上海是国际帝国主义入侵中国的重要基地，也是

page_data.en:

will not stop in the invasion of China. The people in
North East have fallen into hell. Our anti-Japanese
duty is not only to defend the land which has not been
lost, but to restore the North East. In order to achieve this,
the national masses should arm themselves and instruct the
Government to forthwith stop any movement in which arms are
used against the "interior" and to despatch over 80% of its
forces to the North to resist Japan. We should reveal the
intrigue of the Imperialists and the evil of the non-
resistance policy. We should concentrate and consolidate
the anti-Japanese power of the masses. In order to
accomplish this, we should struggle for freedom in speech,
publication, assemblage, organization and other civil rights.
As the volunteers have delayed the carrying out of the plans of the
Imperialists and maintained the glory of the nation, we
should extend the organization of volunteer armies, collect
contributions for their aid. In the struggle against the
Japanese Imperialists, it is not only necessary to secure
success from the military and political viewpoints, but
attention must be paid to economical problems. We should
intensify the boycott movement and confiscate Japanese
goods and make them into powerful and effective weapons,
etc., etc. All the above are the most important tasks
of the national masses, especially the Shanghai masses,
who should shoulder the "vanguard" duties.

In order to carry out the above mentioned duties,
in order to oppose the attack made on North China by the
Japanese Imperialists and in order to commemorate the
deceased martyrs, we call upon the Shanghai masses to
take part in the urgent mass meeting.
page_data.zh:

不会停止对中国的入侵的地方。东北人民已陷入地狱。我们的抗日责任不仅是保卫尚未沦丧的土地，还要收复东北。为了实现这一目标，全国民众应武装起来，并要求政府立即停止任何针对“内部”使用武力的行动，并将其80%以上的兵力派往北方抗日。我们应该揭露帝国主义的阴谋和不抵抗政策的罪恶。我们应该集中和巩固群众的抗日力量。为了实现这一目标，我们应该争取言论、出版、集会、结社和其他公民权利的自由。由于志愿军延缓了帝国主义计划的实施并维护了国家的荣耀，我们应该扩大志愿军的组织，募集捐款予以援助。在对抗日本帝国主义的斗争中，不仅有必要从军事和政治角度确保成功，还必须关注经济问题。我们应该加强抵制运动，没收日货，使其成为强大而有效的武器，等等，等等。以上是全国民众，尤其是上海民众的最重要任务，上海民众应承担“先锋”职责。

为了履行上述职责，为了反对日本帝国主义对华北的进攻，并为了纪念阵亡烈士，我们号召上海民众参加紧急大会。

Subject (in full) Activities of the People's Self Salvation Association

Made by D.S. MacAdie Forwarded by Thos Robertson, Supt.

Preparations by the above body for the holding of
a mass meeting in commemoration of International Labour Day,
May 1, are definitely in hand. While literature coming to not-
ice gives the venue of this meeting as the Public Recreation
Ground, West Gate, all attempts to hold mass gatherings in
this ground since 1931 have failed owing to the closing of
the gates and other precautions taken by the Chinese Police.
A close watch is therefore being kept by the staff of S. 1
with a view to discovering the exact meeting place. Here
follow details of meetings etc., held on April 24.

In compliance with a decision reached at a meeting
of the Southern and Eastern Branches held on April 23, four
representatives of the four district branch offices called
at the Head Office at 2 Tai Lai Li, Markham Road, at about
2 p.m. April 24 and proceeded to the vicinity of the residence
of the Soviet Ambassador, 1607 Sinza Road, with the object of
interviewing the Minister. They left the place without
attempting to enter the premises owing to the presence of
Municipal Police.

Six members of the Organization Section of the
People's Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult held
a meeting in the office of the Southern Branch District

12.15 p.m. April 24 when one Chen Ying (陳英), presided.

page_data.en:
Translation of a handbill entitled "A letter to labour
friends in the Shanghai Eastern District"bearing on
the Anniversary of the International Labour Day purporting
to emanate from the Eastern District Branch of the People's
Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult

All labour friends in the Shanghai Eastern District :

The International Labour day, May 1, is drawing
near. This is a date on which workers of the whole world
rise up and fight for their existence.

Now, as to ourselves ; We are on the point
of death.

The Japanese have occupied the four provinces
in the North East and massacred a great number of Chinese
labourers and peasants. They have now seized Luen-tung
and are striving to attack Peking and Tientsin. They
may even invade the country as far as Shanghai. Our
Government advocated the non-resistance policy the year
before last and declared last year that it would offer
resistance forever. This year "Proceeding to the North"
was the catchword. But in reality, not a single soldier
has been sent, nor a round of ammunition supplied to the
volunteers. They disregard the massacre of our brethren
by the Japanese but use every effort to kill the people
in the interior by big guns and gas. They oppress our
anti-Japanese brethren.

In the Eastern District of Shanghai, the Japanese
capitalists dismiss workers, reduce their wages, assault
and insult them. They are even contemplating closing down
their plants so as to starve us to death. The Chinese
capitalists are blindly following their example by operating
their factories only five days or three days a week.
page_data.zh:
题为《致上海东区劳工朋友书》的传单译文，内容涉及五一国际劳动节纪念日，声称出自救国抗侮会东区分支

上海东区全体劳工朋友：

五一国际劳动节即将来临。这是全世界工人起来为生存而战的日子。

至于我们自己；我们已处于死亡边缘。

日本人占领了东北四省，屠杀了大量中国劳工和农民。他们现在已夺取滦东，并正竭力进攻北平和天津。他们甚至可能入侵至上海。我国政府前年提倡不抵抗政策，去年宣布将永远抵抗。今年“北上”成为口号。但实际上，未派出一兵一卒，也未向义勇军供应一弹一药。他们无视同胞被日本人屠杀，却竭尽全力用大炮和毒气杀害内地人民。他们压迫我们的抗日同胞。

在上海东区，日本资本家解雇工人，降低工资，殴打和侮辱工人。他们甚至正考虑关闭工厂，以便将我们饿死。中国资本家盲目效仿，每周仅开工五天或三天。

page_data.en:
- 2 -

We must save our nation. We must demonstrate our strength
on the "May 1" Festival. With the most earnest desire,
this Association hopes that all labour friends in the
Eastern District will prepare themselves to celebrate "May 1".
Our slogans are :-
1. Let all labourers unite together and commemorate "May 1."
2. Hold a general representative meeting to organize a
"May 1 Preparatory Committee".
3. To commemorate May 1, let us oppose the assault and
insult of Chinese labourers by the Japanese.
4. Oppose the 5 day working system.
5. Confiscate all Japanese goods which will be used to
relieve unemployed workers and North Eastern Volunteer
Corps.
6. Let us demand that the Government send all Chinese troops
to the North in order to restore the lost territory and
defend Peiping and Tientsin as well as release all workers
arrested in connection with the anti-Japanese movement.
page_data.zh:
- 2 -

我们必须拯救国家。我们必须在“五一”节展示我们的力量。本会怀着最诚挚的愿望，希望东区全体劳工朋友做好准备庆祝“五一”。
我们的口号是：-
1. 全体劳工团结起来，纪念“五一”。
2. 召开全体代表会议，组织“五一筹备委员会”。
3. 为纪念五一，让我们反对日本人对中国劳工的殴打和侮辱。
4. 反对五天工作制。
5. 没收所有日货，用于救济失业工人和东北义勇军。
6. 让我们要求政府派遣所有中国军队北上，以收复失地，保卫北平和天津，并释放所有因抗日运动而被捕的工人。

page_data.en:
Translation of a notice issued by the People's Self
Salvation Association to Resist Insult to its various
branch offices on April 24.

------

Since the loss of Jehol, there has been
no proper arrangement at the front to resist further
invasion. Various passes of the Great Wall have been
taken by the enemy and Luen-tung has completely fallen
into their hands. The troops of the Government, it is
said, have been transferred to the South, not the North.
The ambition of the Japanese Imperialists will never
be satisfied with the occupation of Peiping and Tientsin.
The whole of North China will be lost to us and the
danger of having our country divided is pressing. The
crisis will soon become beyond our control, if we hesitate
for a single moment. Worried and anxious, our people
endeavour to find ways for self salvation. Consequently
local public bodies have suggested holding a mass meeting
to discuss the general plan for national salvation as well
as to commemorate the martyrs killed during the anti-
Japanese campaign. As this matter involves a great deal,
we beg to invite the opinions of local public bodies.
It has been decided to hold a Joint Meeting of local public
bodies in the Y.M.C.A. building, Hsicheng, on Monday,
to discuss preparations. The presence of your representative
is earnestly requested.

Signed and sealed: (illegible)
People's Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult
April 24.

救国抗侮会于4月24日向各分支办事处发出的通知译文。

------

自从热河失守以来，前线未有妥善安排以抵抗进一步入侵。长城各关口已被敌人夺取，滦东已完全落入敌手。据悉，政府军队已调往南方，而非北方。日本帝国主义的野心绝不会满足于占领北平和天津。整个华北将沦丧，国家分裂的危险迫在眉睫。如果我们犹豫片刻，危机很快就会变得无法控制。我国人民忧心忡忡，努力寻找自救之道。因此，地方公共团体建议举行群众大会，讨论救国大计，并纪念在抗日运动中牺牲的烈士。鉴于此事关系重大，恳请征求地方公共团体的意见。已决定于星期一在西城青年会大楼举行地方公共团体联席会议，讨论筹备工作。诚请贵方代表出席。

签字盖章：（字迹不清）
救国抗侮会
4月24日。

Summary translation of a handbill entitled "Association
Intelligence" issue No.3, dated April 20, 1933 and
published by the People's Self Salvation Association
to Resist Insult
-----
As a result of the non-resistance policy of
the Government, Chinese territory North of the Great
Wall fell into the hands of the enemy. We should
request the Government to give us weapons in order to
arm ourselves and enable us to proceed to the North and
fight with the enemies of our own accord.
In connection with the raids conducted by the
Police on the Head Office and Branches of the Association,
a dinner party was held at 7 p.m. April 15 in the Sung
Li Restaurant, representatives of local public bodies and
journalists being invited, when accounts of the raids
were given to the attendance. A protest was drafted
during the proceedings containing the following points :
1. That opposition be made to the raids on patriotic
bodies by the Police.
2. That the arrest of members of the Association or any
political be opposed.
3. That political offenders be released.
On the 8th inst. a general meeting of the committee
members of the Nanchih District Branch was held (here
follows an account of resolutions passed at the meeting).
The committee members held a meeting on the same
day when a number of resolutions and recommendations
were adopted in regard to various matters.

针对警察对该会总局及各分会的搜查行动，4月15日晚7时在宋利餐厅（音译）举行晚宴，邀请当地公共团体代表及记者参加，会上向与会者通报了搜查情况。会议期间起草了一份抗议书，包含以下几点：
1. 反对警察搜查爱国团体。
2. 反对逮捕该会成员或任何政治人士。
3. 释放政治犯。

Summary Translation of a handbill entitled "A
Manifesto bearing on the establishment of the Northern
District Branch of the People's Self Salvation Association
to Resist Insult" purporting to emanate from this
Body.

--------

Since the "September 18" and "January 28"
Incidents the Imperialists are continuously oppressing
and attempting to dismember our "semi-colonized" China
and the Japanese Imperialists have even invaded North
China. It will be remembered that the lives of many
innocent people were lost during the January 28 Incident.
It is useless to depend upon the League of Nations to
uphold justice and upon the policy of long resistance
of the Government. If we do not resist and overthrow
the Japanese Imperialists of our own accord no other
body will render us any assistance. Another
January 28 Incident will take place and citizens in
North Shanghai cannot evade being slaughtered. In
order to avoid being massacred, preparations must be
made beforehand and therefore it is necessary for us to
organize the Northern District Branch of the People's
Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult.

自“九一八”和“一·二八”事变以来，帝国主义者不断压迫并企图肢解我们这“半殖民地”的中国，日本帝国主义者甚至侵入了华北。众所周知，在“一·二八”事变期间，许多无辜百姓丧生。依赖国际联盟主持公道以及政府的长期抵抗政策是无用的。如果我们不自动起来抵抗并推翻日本帝国主义者，没有任何其他团体会给予我们援助。另一次“一·二八”事变将会发生，闸北市民无法逃避被屠杀的命运。为了避免被屠杀，必须事先做好准备，因此我们有必要组织人民抗侮自救会北区支会。

April 24, 1933.    Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE CITIZENS' AGGRESSION RESISTANCE AND
SELF-SALVATION ASSOCIATION.

Madame Sun Yat-sen has tendered the following
letter of resignation to the Citizens' Aggression Resistance
and Self-Salvation Association:-
When the delegate of your Association called
upon me on April 12, I was sick and could not receive
him.
The Civil Rights Protection League has
requested Lawyer Sung Kyien Sz to undertake the
negotiations with the Shanghai Municipal Council over
the search of the Association by the Shanghai Municipal
Police. He will also request the Chinese authorities
to release the propagandists of the Association.
As I am already too much occupied with work
connected with other organisations, I beg to resign
from the chairmanship of the Association. I shall
continue to assist the Association as a member.

Wu Mai also Resigns.

The Association has sent the following
letter to lawyer Wu Mai requesting him to withdraw
his resignation from the post of vice-Chairman of the
Association:-
Your letter of resignation from the post of
vice-Chairman of the Association will be considered by
the Executive Committee of Association on April 26.
During this stage of national crisis it is the duty of
the Association to struggle hard, and no member of the
Association should evade duty of serving his country.
The intense patriotism displayed by the people indicates
a bright future for the country.
The opponents of the Association are rejoicing
at the news of your resignation. It is a matter of regret
that you are resigning at this moment when so many
knotty problems are awaiting solution. Please withdraw
your resignation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE CABLE COMPANIES.

The International Telegraph Bureau of the
Ministry of Communications will formally take over the control
of the Receiving and Transmitting Departments of the Great
Northern, the Eastern Extension and the Pacific Cable
Companies on May 1.
The messengers formally employed by the cable
companies will be controlled by the chiefs of the
Departments appointed by the Ministry. They will wear
uniforms and caps made according to the designs approved
by the Ministry.
The Department Chiefs will take oath and assume
office in the auditorium of the International Telegraph
Bureau on May 1.

D. C. (Divisions) :

I forward herewith four spare copies of reports
dated April 21 and April 22, 1933, regarding two
political organizations called "The People's Rights
Protection League" and "The People's Self Salvation
Association to Resist Insult". I shall be thankful
if you will give the copies to the D.O'S and request
them to instruct the districts concerned to keep a
watch on the societies and report
from time to time on the activities in which they
are engaged. As you will see from the attached file
the subversive propaganda being conducted by these
two bodies is likely to cause serious trouble in view
of the increase of unemployment owing to trade depression.
As a matter of fact, it is suspected that these organiza-
tions have been established by persons employed by agents
of the III International to work on behalf of the
Section of Communist Activities known as the "legal line".

J. Gwinne

Subject (in full) Activities of the People's Rights Protection League
and the People's Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult
Made by D.S. MacAdie Forwarded by Ths Robertson Sub

In the middle of December 1932 a new body known as
the People's Rights Protection League of China came into
existence. This organization the promoters of which were
Madame Sun Yat-sen and Dr. Tsai Yuan-pei, members of the
C.E.C. of the Kuomintang, first came to the notice of the
Municipal Police on December 31 when it entertained local
journalists in the China United Apartments, 104 Bubbling
Well Road.

The avowed objects of this body are to safeguard
the people's rights such as freedom of assembly, speech,
publication etc., and to oppose the arrest and torture of
political offenders. The Shanghai Branch of the League
was formally inaugurated on January 17 in the Central
Research Institute, Avenue du Roi Albert. The foregoing
promoters were elected to the Executive Committee together
with seven others and the League continued its propaganda
along the lines of its stated principles paying particular
attention to the case of the execution of the editor of
a Chinkiang newspaper by General Koo Tsoh Dong for publishing
reactionary articles.

On March 8 an offshoot of the body came to notice
with the formation of a "People's National Salvation
Association to Resist Insult" by Madame Sun and Tu Mai,
the lawyer also a member of the League, in the Chinese
Y.M.C.A. Restaurant, Szechuen Road. This organization
appeared from the speeches made and the resolutions passed
to be reactionary in character and bordering on communistic.

Shortly afterwards on March 18 a new executive
committee of the parent organization was elected which

主题（全称）民权保障同盟及人民抗侮自救会的活动
由 D.S. MacAdie 制作，经 Ths Robertson 副巡官转发

1932年12月中旬，一个名为“中国民权保障同盟”的新团体成立。该组织由国民党中央执行委员孙逸仙夫人和蔡元培博士发起，首次引起工部局警务处注意是在12月31日，当时它在静安寺路104号中国联合公寓招待本地记者。

该团体宣称的目标是保障人民的权利，如集会、言论、出版自由等，并反对逮捕和折磨政治犯。该同盟上海分会于1月17日在阿尔贝国王路中央研究院正式成立。上述发起人当选为执行委员会委员，另有七人当选，同盟继续按照其既定原则进行宣传，特别关注镇江一家报纸编辑因刊登反动文章而被顾作栋将军处决一案。

3月8日，该团体的一个分支引起注意，孙夫人和杜迈（律师，也是同盟成员）在四川路中华基督教青年会餐厅成立了“人民国民抗侮救国会”。从发表的演讲和通过的决议来看，该组织具有反动性质，且带有共产主义色彩。

Summary translation of a handbill dated April 15,
entitled"Protesting against the oppression of the
Association, the apprehension and assault of members
by the Japanese Imperialists" and purporting to
emanate from the "Shanghai Southern District Branch
of the People's Self Salvation Association to Resist
Insult.

While cities after cities in the North
are falling to the hands of the Japanese Imperialists,
Chian Kai Shek has suddenly left Paoting and went to
Nanchang to pursue his old policy, "to resist outward
invasion, we must first settle the internal strife".
Everybody knows that during the present
crisis the salvation of our nation depends upon our
people. With this object in view, this Association
has sprung into existence and its uprightness is
manifested in the ardent support which it receives
from the people in Shanghai as well as other places.
Regulations and manifestoes have been forwarded to
both the Settlement and the Chinese Authorities.
Do their contents prove wrong or illegal? Therefore
any one who desires the salvation of the Chinese nation
should never oppress this Association.
The Japanese Imperialists however are brutal.
They ally themselves with the Settlement Authorities
and the Chinese traitors to endeavour to nullify our
efforts.
At the beginning, the Japanese Imperialists
induced the Police to attempt to prohibit the inaugural
meeting of the Shanghai Eastern District Branch Office.
Later they instigated the Japanese policemen to assault
the four propagandists of our Branch Office while they
page_data.zh:
题为《抗议日本帝国主义者压迫本会、逮捕并
殴打会员》的传单摘要译文，日期为4月15日，声
称出自“上海人民救国抗侮会南区分部”。

当北方城市一座接一座落入日本帝国主义者
手中时，蒋介石突然离开保定，前往南昌，继续推
行其旧政策，“欲御外侮，必先安内”。众所周知，
在当前危机中，国家的存亡取决于我国人民。本着
这一目标，本会应运而生，其正直性体现在上海
及其他地方民众给予的热情支持中。章程和宣言
已递交给租界当局和中国当局。其内容难道证明
是错误或非法的吗？因此，任何希望拯救中华民
族的人都不应压迫本会。
然而，日本帝国主义者残暴无比。他们勾结
租界当局和中国汉奸，企图使我们的努力化为泡
影。
起初，日本帝国主义者唆使警方试图禁止上
海东区分部办事处的成立大会。后来，他们煽动
日本警察袭击我们分部办事处的四名宣传员，当时他们

page_data.en:
- 2 -

were delivering speeches at the Shanghai No.5 Cotton
Mill. These four members were subsequently taken to
the Yulin Road Police Station and released only after
our people showed strong opposition. Recently the
British and French Police raided on the evening of
April 9 the Main Office of the Association and the
Shanghai Southern District Branch Office. In addition
no information has been received of the four members
of the Shanghai Northern District Branch office since
their arrest. These incidents are indeed insulting
to the Chinese nation. The Imperialists are suppressing
our movement of emancipation. We must break through this
oppression otherwise we can not hope to materialize our
plans for national salvation. People, Rise up!
1. Oppose the search of the People's Self Salvation
Association to Resist Japan!
2. Oppose the arrest of its members!
3. Compensate all the losses!
4. Release the four members of the Shanghai Northern
District Branch!
5. Resist unreasonable oppression!
6. Struggle for the absolute freedom in the anti-
Japanese and national salvation movement!
7. Release all political offenders!

1. 反对搜查人民救国抗侮会！

Translation of a handbill entitled "A manifesto to
welcome the Oriental Inspection Delegation of the
World Anti-War Association" dated April 16, 1933
and purporting to emanate from the People's Self
Salvation Association to Resist Insult.

------

On January 28 the Japanese bombarded Shanhai.
The British, American, French and Italian Imperialists
were frightened by resistance put forth by the 19th
Route Army and the united strength of our revolutionary
people. We have decided to arm all our people and
organize Volunteer Corps and the People's Self Defence
Group to proceed to the North. We will demand that the
National Government release all political offenders,
who are warriors in fighting against the Japanese and
the Imperialists. Lastly we will extend the boycott
movement : all Chinese should not purchase Japanese
goods and these goods be confiscated so as to shorten
the economic life of the Japanese Imperialists.

的传单译文，日期为1933年4月16日，声称出自人
民救国抗侮会。

------

1月28日，日本轰炸上海。英、美、法、意帝国
主义者被第十九路军的抵抗和我们革命人民的团
结力量所吓倒。我们决定武装全体人民，组织义勇
军和人民自卫团北上。我们将要求国民政府释放
所有政治犯，他们是抗击日本人和帝国主义者的
战士。最后，我们将扩大抵制运动：所有中国人不
得购买日本货物，并没收这些货物，以缩短日本帝
国主义者的经济寿命。

page_data.en:
Translation of cartoons dated April 19, entitled
Anti-Insult Pictorial and purporting to emanate
from the Southern Branch Office of the People's
Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult.

-----

This pictorial contains/cartoons: -

1) Depicting a group of people carrying badges
inscribed "Welcome the Soviet Minister to
China who sympathizes with weak races" and
"Welcome the Delegation from France".

2) Depicting 3 persons each raising one of their
hands and bearing the following slogans:-
a) We should participate in the Self Salvation
Association to Resist Insult!
b) We should convene a mass meeting!
c) We should arm ourselves and organize volunteer
corps to proceed to the North to resist Japan!
d) We should urge the Government to mobilize
the troops of the nation to resist Japan!

3) Showing three aeroplanes one of which bears
the Japanese national emblem 卍 carrying out
a bombardment. Some houses are depicted as
wrecked and people are lying on the ground.

4) Depicting four persons on one side, on the overcoat
of one is written "Lytton Commission and Report"
holding a piece of paper bearing the Chinese
characters:
"How to divide China?"
"How to put China under the International
Administration?"
and four persons on the other side one of whom
carries a badge inscribed "Delegation from France"
while another is saying "We oppose the brutal
action of Japan and are coming to the support
of our oppressed Chinese people".
Above this picture is written "We oppose the Lytton
Commission but welcome the Delegation from France".

1933年4月19日题为《抗辱画报》的漫画译文，据称发自民众救国抗辱会南市分会。

-----

该画报包含以下漫画：-

1) 描绘一群人佩戴徽章，上书“欢迎同情弱小民族的苏联部长来华”及“欢迎法国代表团”。

2) 描绘三人各举一手，标语如下：-
a) 我们应参加救国抗辱会！
b) 我们应召开群众大会！
c) 我们应武装起来，组织义勇军北上抗日！
d) 我们应敦促政府动员全国军队抗日！

3) 显示三架飞机，其中一架带有日本国徽卍字，正在进行轰炸。画面中一些房屋被毁，人们倒在地上。

4) 一侧描绘四人，其中一人外套上写有“李顿调查团及报告书”，手持一张纸，上书汉字：
“如何瓜分中国？”
“如何将中国置于国际共管之下？”
另一侧描绘四人，其中一人佩戴写有“法国代表团”的徽章，另一人称：“我们反对日本的暴行，前来支持受压迫的中国人民”。
此图上方写有“我们反对李顿调查团，但欢迎法国代表团”。

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
File No.
No. D 4616
Date APRIL 22, 1933）

Subject (in full) Industrial Situation - letter dated April 18, 1933
from the Chinese Cotton Mill Owners' Association

Made by and Forwarded by Superintendent Robertson

Reference was made to this meeting in the Police
Intelligence Summary of April 11. Pessimism reigns in
local industrial circles at the moment and there is
every indication that the depression has by no means
touched bottom. The situation generally affords a
golden opportunity to "reds" and radicals for the
carrying out of subversive activities in the labour
field. One indication that this state of affairs is
being taken advantage of is the springing up of branches
of the "People's Self Salvation Association to Resist
Insult" an organization sponsored by Wu Mai, the lawyer,
and like firebrands who are striving for notoriety.
A report on the activities and location of these
branches is being compiled and will be submitted to you
to-day.

Jno Robertson
Superintendent.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（签名）
APR 22 1933

主题（全称）工业状况 - 1933年4月18日华商纱厂联合会来信

由罗伯逊警司制作并转发

4月11日的警务情报摘要中曾提及此次会议。目前本地工业界弥漫着悲观情绪，种种迹象表明经济萧条远未触底。总体局势为“赤色分子”和激进分子在劳工领域开展颠覆活动提供了绝佳机会。利用这一局势的一个迹象是，“民众救国抗辱会”各分会纷纷成立，该组织由律师吴迈（Wu Mai）及其他旨在博取名声的煽动者赞助。关于这些分会的活动及地点的报告正在编制中，将于今日呈交阁下。

约翰·罗伯逊
警司。

特务处处长。

（签名）
1933年4月22日

POLICE FORCE
（批：9 APR '33）

CHINESE COTTON MILLOWNERS' ASSOCIATION.

April 18, 1933.

The Secretary,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
Shanghai.

Dear Sir,

In view of the accumulation of cotton yarn and piece goods, owing to lack of demand from the interior, in all the Cotton Mills: a conference of the Chinese Cotton Millowners' Association was held on 10th April at 80, Avenue Edward VII, Shanghai, at the recommendation of the Executive Committee. Thirty-six delegates from forty-six mills in Shanghai, Tientsin, Wusih, Hankow and other ports which represents over 2 million spindles and 13,000 looms, or 80% of spindles of the whole country, attended the conference and partial curtailment of operation was discussed. The following resolutions had been carried.

"That production in all the mills operated by the members of the Association be curtailed by either stopping work on Saturdays and Sundays or reducing working time by 25% for one month beginning from April 22nd to May 21st, and that every member of the Association be required to report in due course to the Supervisory Committee of the Association which way he intends to follow in the way of curtailment."

"That the staff staying in the mills be paid at half rate during the period when work is suspended and that no pay be granted to those who are absent from the mills."

"That Messrs. Wang Shu-ning, Li Shen-peh and Sien Chung-sui be appointed to the Supervisory Committee for supervising the curtailment of operations in Shanghai and"

华商纱厂联合会。

1933年4月18日。

致秘书，
上海公共租界工部局，
上海。

尊敬的先生：

鉴于内地需求匮乏，导致所有棉纺厂的棉纱和布匹积压，根据执行委员会的建议，华商纱厂联合会于4月10日在上海爱多亚路80号召开会议。来自上海、天津、无锡、汉口及其他港口的46家纱厂的36名代表出席了会议，这些纱厂拥有超过200万锭纱锭和13,000台织机，占全国纱锭总数的80%，会议讨论了部分缩减生产事宜。通过以下决议。

“自4月22日至5月21日止的一个月内，联合会会员经营的所有工厂要么在周六和周日停工，要么减少25%的工作时间，以此缩减生产；并要求联合会每位成员及时向联合会监察委员会报告其打算采取的缩减方式。”

“在停工期间，留厂职员的薪资减半发放，离厂人员不予发薪。”

“任命王叔宁、李升伯和先仲遂三位先生组成监察委员会，负责监督上海的减产工作，并且”

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY. No. 466）
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
（批：Date April 19th 33.）

Subject (in full) Reference the arrest of four alleged communists
by officers from Yulin Road Station on April 7, 1933.
Made by D. S. I. Golder Forwarded by Tho Robertson, Supt.

At about 7.30 p.m. on April 7, 1933, I was
informed that officers from Yulin Road Station had
arrested three male and one female Chinese on Tsitsihar
Road for distributing handbills.

Prior to proceeding to Yulin Road, I telephoned
to Superintendent Robertson at his residence and passed
on the information.

Upon arrival at the Yulin Road Station I learned
that the pamphlets were of anti-Japanese nature and called
upon the workers of the Japanese cotton mills to strike
and oppose illtreatment at the hands of their Japanese
employers. These handbills purported to emanate from
the Eastern District Branch of the People's Self Salvation
Association to Resist Insult.

A full translation of the documents was not
made on the spot but the gist of their text was conveyed to
Superintendent Robertson who, upon learning that they
emanated from the Association headed by Wu Mai, instructed
me that unless they contained matter of an inciting nature
or sufficient grounds to justify prosecution, which would
result in the suppression of Wu Mai and his clique, it
would be better to allow the four arrested persons to
proceed after a severe caution had been given them.

On the occasion in question three different
kinds of leaflet were seized, namely,
(A) The Regulations of the Association.
(B) Correspondence on Association Affairs.
(C) A manifesto denouncing the Japanese capitalist
for alleged illtreatment of Chinese labourers.

主题（全称）关于1933年4月7日榆林路站警员逮捕四名涉嫌共产党分子一事。
由 D. S. I. Golder 制作，由 Tho Robertson 警司转发。

1933年4月7日晚7时30分左右，我获悉榆林路站警员在齐齐哈尔路逮捕了三名男性和一名女性中国人，原因是他们分发传单。

在前往榆林路站之前，我打电话给住在家中的罗伯逊警司，通报了此信息。

抵达榆林路站后，我得知这些传单具有反日性质，呼吁日本棉纺厂的工人罢工，反对日本雇主的虐待。这些传单据称发自民众救国抗辱会东区分会。

现场未对文件进行完整翻译，但将其大意传达给了罗伯逊警司。罗伯逊警司得知传单出自吴迈领导的协会后指示我，除非传单包含煽动性内容或有足够理由提起诉讼，从而能够取缔吴迈及其团伙，否则最好在给予严厉警告后释放这四名被捕者。

在此次事件中缴获了三种不同的传单，即：
(A) 协会章程。
(B) 关于协会事务的通信。
(C) 谴责日本资本家所谓虐待中国工人的宣言。

S.I, Special Branch.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C & S.B. REGISTRY Title No. 4606 Date April 18/1933）

Subject (in full) Peoples Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult - activities from April 13 to 14.

Made by D.S.I. Golder Forwarded by Tho Robertson, Supt.

Nine members of the Shanghai Southern District
Branch of the above Association held a meeting in their
office, 19 Min Teh Li, Avenue Joffre between 3.30 and 5.10
p.m. April 13 when the following resolutions were
discussed and passed :-

1. That a registration office of a People's Self Defending
Group be established with the object of enlisting new
members.

2. That arrangements be made for the loan of the Public
Recreation Ground or the recreation grounds of local
schools for recreation purposes.

3. That a Japanese Goods Inspection Committee be organized
with branch groups among the following :-
Seamen
Sailors
Wharf coolies

4. That a manifesto be issued with a view to enlisting
members for these groups.

5. That General Wong Teh-ling be requested to give lectures.

6. That local Chinese papers be requested to publish
accounts of the raid on this office by the Police.

7. That local cinema theatres be requested to show anti-
Japanese slogans.

8. That membership fees be collected.

9. That branches of this office be established in local
schools.

10. That local schools and public bodies be urged to join
the Special Committee of this office to welcome the
delegation composed of members of the Anti-War Society

April 17, 1933.    Morning Translat

MISCELLANEOUS.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:-

DRUNKEN AMERICAN SOLDIERS CAUSE MOTOR CAR ACCIDENT

At 11 p.m. last night, four drunken american soldiers rushed into the Ziang Seng Motor Hire Shop, Rue Mortaban, French Concession, seized a car and drove away in it. The car knocked down two Chinese in the vicinity of the Great World Resort. The American soldiers escaped but one of them was arrested by the French Police.

The Eastern Times and other local news papers:-

THE PEOPLE'S AGGRESSION RESISTANCE AND SELF-SALVATION ASSOCIATION.

At 7 p.m. yesterday, the People's Aggression Resistance and Self Salvation Association entertained a number of public bodies in the Victory Hotel, Rue Bourgeat. About 40 persons were present including Hsu Sial Tien, Wong Chai Tz, Loo Sz Tsang, and Loh Yung, members of the Blood and Soul Corps for the Extermination of Traitors.
Lawyer Wu Lei, who presided, made the following statement:-
"This Association is a genuine patriotic body and has not done anything contrary to law or against the peace and order of the district. Yet the imperialists have adopted measures of oppression and this action is truly insulting to the entire people of our country. They have entered our rooms to search and destroy without legal authority. The safety of citizens from now on is in danger. This Association earnestly hopes that the public will rise up to protest."

Shun Pao -

THE TELEGRAPH AGREEMENT.

The Great Northern, the Great Eastern and the Pacific Telegraph Companies have promised to restore the cable landing rights to China.
According to responsible men of the Ministry of Communications, the submarine cable landing right will soon be taken over but the cables will be leased to the three Companies at a certain fee. The Ministry has commissioned three officers to take over the receiving and dispatching departments of the Companies in a few days.

《申报》及其他当地报纸：

醉酒美国士兵引发车祸

昨晚11时，四名醉酒的美国士兵冲进法租界莫尔坦路（Rue Mortaban）的祥生汽车行，抢走一辆汽车后驾车离去。该车在大世界游乐场附近撞倒两名中国人。美国士兵逃逸，但其中一人被法国警察逮捕。

《字林西报》及其他当地报纸：

国民抗侮自救会。

昨晚7时，国民抗侮自救会在布尔热路（Rue Bourgeat）的胜利饭店宴请了一些公共团体。约40人出席，其中包括“铁血锄奸团”成员徐雪天（Hsu Sial Tien）、黄载之（Wong Chai Tz）、卢子昌（Loo Sz Tsang）和陆庸（Loh Yung）。
主持会议的律师吴雷（Wu Lei，即吴迈）发表如下声明：
“本会是真正的爱国团体，未做任何违法或违背本地区和平秩序之事。然而帝国主义者采取压迫措施，此举确实是对我国全体人民的侮辱。他们在没有法律依据的情况下进入我们的房间进行搜索和破坏。今后公民的安全处于危险之中。本会恳切希望公众起来抗议。”

《申报》：

电报协定。

大北、大东及太平洋电报公司已承诺恢复中国的电缆登陆权。
据交通部负责人称，海底电缆登陆权很快将被收回，但电缆将以一定费用租赁给这三家公司。部里已委派三名官员在几天内接管各公司的收发部门。

Subject (in full) Report of interview with the Secretary of the Shanghai
Cotton Mill Headquarters.

Made by Inspector Isaacs Forwarded by Inspector Stubbings.

Sir,
At about 10am 8/4/33 Mr. T. Kageyama, Secretary of the Shanghai
Cotton Mill Headquarters called at the Station, and on being
interviewed by the undersigned, requested an explanation as to
why 4 students, arrested outside No. 5 Mill, Lay Road, at about
6pm 7/4/33 for distributing Anti Japanese, and alleged Communistic
pamphlets to the mill workers were released from this Station
and no charge preferred against them.
It was explained to him that after arrest, the Special Branch,
were informed, this Branch being the proper persons to investigate
cases of this nature, and, that two of that Branch attended this
Station and conducted investigations the result of which, was,
that nothing could be found which would warrant a charge being
preferred.
Mr. Kageyama then suggested, that they should have been
charged with committing a breach of the peace, and on being asked,
in what manner a breach of the peace had been committed, he stated
that one of the pamphlets contained some demands against the No. 5
Mill, which, if not granted a strike should be called. He was then
told that the pamphlet referred to, was merely Anti-Japanese, the
distributing of which did not constitute a breach of the peace,
and that there was nothing in the Criminal Code under which persons
could be charged with distributing Anti-Japanese literature.
The Secretary then asked for the names and addresses of the
arrested students, but after communicating with the Special Branch,
he was told this could not be done. He then asked if the case was
concluded, and was told, that it was finished only as far as this
Station was concerned, but that the Special Branch were in all
probability carrying out further investigations, and suggested

制作人：督察 Isaacs 呈报人：督察 Stubbings。

先生，
1933年4月8日上午10点左右，上海棉纺厂总部秘书 T. Kageyama 先生来到巡捕房，在接受本人问询时，要求解释为何四名于1933年4月7日下午6点左右在雷路五厂外因向工厂工人分发抗日及涉嫌共产主义传单而被捕的学生，从本巡捕房获释且未被起诉。
向他解释说，逮捕后，特别科获悉此事，该科是调查此类案件的适当人员，该科的两名人员来到本巡捕房并进行了调查，结果是，找不到任何足以支持起诉的理由。
Kageyama 先生随后建议，应以扰乱治安罪对他们提起诉讼，当被问及以何种方式扰乱治安时，他表示其中一份传单包含针对第五厂的一些要求，如果不满足这些要求，就应发动罢工。随后告诉他，所提及的传单仅仅是反日的，分发此类传单不构成扰乱治安，且《刑法典》中没有任何条款可据此起诉分发反日文献的人员。
秘书随后要求提供被捕学生的姓名和地址，但在与特别科联系后，他被告知这无法做到。他随后询问案件是否已结案，并被告知，就本巡捕房而言案件已结束，但特别科很可能正在进行进一步调查，并建议

April 7, 30

Political (2)

were put before the attendance and passed :-

1. That the Government be asked to forthwith despatch all forces and aeroplanes it possesses to the North to resist Japan and to restore Jehol and Manchuria within a fixed time.

2. That the Government be asked to forthwith supply the North Eastern Volunteer Armies with military requirements.

3. That a fund be raised by collecting contributions among the people for the aid of the North Eastern Volunteers and sufferers.

4. That a Liquidation Committee be organized to liquidate accounts of funds for the aid of the North Eastern Volunteer Armies.

5. That the people's rights (freedom in speech, publication, assemblies and organization) be protected and that opposition be made to the arrest, detention and tongue-lashing of anti-Japanese and anti-Imperialist masses; that all political offenders be released and that the law regarding the punishment of persons who commit Acts with intent to injure the Republic of China as well as the Press Law be nullified from date.

6. That the Government at once issue arms to the people, organize Citizen's Self Defence Corps and Volunteer Corps to proceed to the North.

7. That in defiance of the nation regardless of their own social status, class, profession, occupation with a view to defend the Chinese Nation, and to develop the strength of resistance of the citizens for the support of the North Eastern Volunteer Army.
