March 18, 1933.
Morning Translation.

MISCELLANEOUS

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE PEOPLE'S HUMILIATION RESISTANCE ASSOCIATION: ITS PURPOSE.

The Chinese People's Humiliation Resistance & Self-Salvation Association, promoted by Madame Sun Yat Sen, lawyer Wu Mei (吴迈), lawyer Tung Kong (董康), lawyer Sz Liang (史良), Chen Ping Woo (陈彬和), a newspaperman, and others, has been inaugurated. It has a communication address in lawyer Wu Mei's office at No. 48 Route Vallon in the French Concession. Madame Sun is the Chairman of the Standing Committee of the Association.

At 5 p.m. yesterday, the Association received local newspapermen at the Tsoong Zoen Club on Weihaiwei Road.

Wu Mei made the following report on the organization of the Association:- "The January 28 Incident occurred after the loss of the Three Eastern Provinces. The true attitude of the League of Nations has been revealed by the Lytton Report. The decision of the Committee of Nineteen has come to nothing. At the present moment when foreign insults are being heaped upon China and the existence of the people is in danger, China will be annihilated if the people throughout the country do not concentrate their strength to save her. In view of this, we have organised this Association whose object will be to struggle for the maintenance of China's independence and unification and of her territorial integrity.

"The following will serve as a guide to the people in their struggles:-
1) To request the Government to lose no time in dispatching all the national troops to North China for the recovery of the North East and Jehol. Over 80 per cent of the national military expenditure should be devoted to the anti-Japanese armies and every aeroplane in the country should proceed to the North to participate in the anti-Japanese campaign.
2) The Government should be urged to arm the people.
3) To request the Government to protect the people's rights and to grant freedom of speech, publication, meeting and organization.
4) To support the North-Eastern Volunteer Armies.
5) To enlarge the boycott movement.

"The most important duties of the people at the present time are as follows:-
1) To request people in various walks of life to join the Association.
2) To organise a People's Armed Self-Defence Committee.
3) To organise a Subscriptions Soliciting Committee.
4) To welcome the members of the Eastern District Inspection Group of the World Anti-Imperialist League, which is coming to China.

"All local newspapermen should urge the people to resist insult and to work for self-salvation. They should publish as much news of the doings of the Association as possible so that its aims may become known to all."

A de M 18.3.33.

杂项

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

国民救侮自权会：其宗旨。

由孙逸仙夫人、律师吴迈（Wu Mei）、律师董康（Tung Kong）、律师史良（Sz Liang）、报人陈彬和（Chen Ping Woo）等人发起的“中国国民救侮自权会”已正式成立。其通讯地址设在法租界华伦路48号吴迈律师办事处。孙夫人为该会常务委员会主席。

昨日下午5时，该会在威海卫路宗正俱乐部（Tsoong Zoen Club）接待了本地报界人士。

吴迈就该会的组织情况作了如下报告：“‘一·二八’事变发生在东三省沦陷之后。李顿调查报告揭示了国际联盟的真实态度。十九国委员会的决定已落空。在目前外国侮辱加诸中国、人民生存危在旦夕之际，若全国民众不集中力量自救，中国必将灭亡。有鉴于此，我们组织了本会，其目标是为维护中国的独立、统一及领土完整而斗争。

“以下各项将作为民众斗争的指导方针：
1) 请求政府立即派遣所有国军北上，以收复东北和热河。国家军费支出的80%以上应用于抗日军队，全国所有飞机应北上参加抗日战役。
2) 敦促政府武装民众。
3) 请求政府保护民权，给予言论、出版、集会和结社自由。
4) 支援东北义勇军。
5) 扩大抵制运动。

“目前民众最重要的职责如下：
1) 呼吁各界人士加入本会。
2) 组织民众武装自卫委员会。
3) 组织募捐委员会。
4) 欢迎即将来华的世界反帝同盟东区视察团成员。

“所有本地报界人士应敦促民众抵抗侮辱，致力于自救。他们应尽可能多地刊登本会活动的新闻，以便让所有人了解其宗旨。”

A de M 1933年3月18日。

March 18, 1933. Morning Translation

MISCELLANEOUS

The Association has issued the following
circular telegram:-
"The Japanese Imperialists are continuing
their armed aggression in China. They have occupied
the Three Eastern Provinces, bombarded Shanghai and
invaded Shanhaikwan and Jehol. The officials responsible
for the defence of the national soil have deserted their
posts and have treacherously worked for the safety of their
possessions. In the Sino-Japanese hostilities in
Shanghai, the authorities wrecked the Chinese military
plans by concluding an armistice, while during the Japanese
attack on Shanhaikwan and Jehol, these same authorities
used the troops in civil strife. While the brutal
Japanese are penetrating China step by step, we are
pitilessly killing one another. What a humiliation!
"Soldiers, come to your senses! The national
danger is as critical as a heavy weight hanging by a hair.
Our enemies are the Japanese Imperialists. We must unite,
and proceed to the North to resist Japan, to recover the
lost territory in the North-East and to defend North China.
We must stand by our people and soldiers at Hsifengkow
to maintain the independence of our country and the
integrity of our territory. Let us mobilize, put a stop
to all civil wars, proceed to the North to kill our enemies
and swear to support the soldiers who are fighting the
Japanese. Let us shout 'Long live the soldiers who are
fighting the Japanese!'".

To-day being the anniversary of the Peiping
People's Revolution, the local Tangpu will hold a meeting

Representatives of various public bodies,

ALLEGATION AGAINST S.M.C. BY CHINESE FILM CENSORS.
The Film Censorship Committee has sent a petition

permitted Japanese to screen pictures which are insulting
to China.
The Ministry of Education sent a letter to the
Ministry of Foreign Affairs on March 17, requesting it
to lodge a protest.

该会发布了下列通电：
“日本帝国主义者继续在中国进行武装侵略。他们占领了东三省，轰炸上海，并入侵山海关和热河。负责保卫国土的官员弃职潜逃，为保全私产而卖国求荣。在上海的中日冲突中，当局通过缔结停战协定破坏了中国军事计划；而在日军进攻山海关和热河期间，这些当局又将军队用于内战。当残暴的日本人一步步深入中国时，我们却在无情地自相残杀。这是何等的耻辱！
“士兵们，清醒过来吧！国家危如累卵。我们的敌人是日本帝国主义者。我们必须团结起来，北上抗日，收复东北失地，保卫华北。我们必须与喜峰口的军民站在一起，维护国家独立和领土完整。让我们动员起来，停止一切内战，北上杀敌，并誓言支持抗战士兵。让我们高呼‘抗战士兵万岁！’”。

People's National Salvation Association to Resist Insult -
new body formed

Fifty Chinese who claimed to represent local public
bodies held a dinner party in the Y.M.C.A. Restaurant, 201
Szechuen Road, between 7 and 11 p.m. March 8, when it
was decided to organize a new body entitled "People's
National Salvation Association to Resist Insult"
(国民救侮自权会). The attendance included
Madame Sun Yat-sen and Yu Kai, the firebrand lawyer,
who made speeches criticising the weak attitude of the
National Government in the Sino-Japanese dispute and
blaming Chang Hsueh-liang for the loss of Chinese soil
to the Japanese in the North East. They denounced
the National Government for having failed in their
duty towards the people, intimating that it was only
seeking to compromise with imperialism. The following
resolutions were passed :-
1. That all the Chinese forces be mobilised and sent to
the North East.
2. That the people be formed into armed forces.
3. That the people's rights be not suppressed and that the
arrested revolutionaries be released.
4. That the attack on the Soviet Consulate in Shenyang be
denounced.

MISCELLANEOUS

China Times

THE PEOPLE'S SELF-SALVATION ASSOCIATION TO
RESIST AGGRESSION.

The People's Self-Salvation Association To
Resist Aggression gave a dinner party to representatives
of local public bodies in the Chinese Y.M.C.A.Restaurant,
Szechuen Road, at 6 p.m. yesterday. Among those present
were Madame Sun Yat Sen, Yang Ken Vuh (楊杏佛), President
of the Central Research Institute, Chen Ah Fu (陳亞夫),
representative of the North-Eastern Volunteers Support
Committee, Hu Mei (胡楣), representative of the Europe-
Asia Aviation Company, Tsai Ho Hui (蔡和惠), representative
of the Chinese Y.M.C.A., Wu Lei (吳雷), representative of
the Bar Association, and representatives of 40 other public
bodies.

Li Chien Hua (李劍華), who presided, in
outlining the object of the Association, stated that
foreign aggression is ever increasing and that the
national crisis is becoming graver. Yang Hen Vuh and
lawyer Yu Hsi also delivered speeches.

Madame Sun Yat Sen, member of the Preparatory
Committee of the Association, made a lengthy address (full
text appears in the "China Press" of to-day) in the course
of which she spoke of industrial and agricultural
development on a socialistic basis, the abolition of
extortion, the success of the 5-Year Plan in Soviet Union
and the deepening crisis in capitalistic countries. She
criticised existing conditions in this country and
continued: "We call upon all men, women and youth in
China, especially the labourers, peasants and volunteers,
to unite and struggle for our emancipation, the unification
and integrity of China, freedom of speech, press and
assembly for the people of China and the release of all
political offenders. In every city and village in the
country we must struggle and demand (1) that at least 80%
of the national military forces be equipped with adequate
armaments and aeroplanes and sent to resist the Japanese
Imperialism, to recover Jehol and to defend China, (2)
that the people be armed and organized into a People's
Self-Protection Corps, and (3) that the democratic
rights, such as the freedom of speech, press and assembly,
be restored and that the imprisonment, torture and execution
of revolutionaries be abolished".

A discussion then took place regarding the
formation of the Association and the appointment of
representatives, after which the following resolutions
were passed:-
(1) That General Chiang Kai Shek be requested to proceed
personally to the front to direct the national forces
in recovering the lost territory.
(2) That the National Government be requested to issue
immediately adequate equipment to the North-East
Volunteers.

民众救国抗敌会。

民众救国抗敌会于昨日下午六时，在四川路青年会餐厅宴请本地各公共团体代表。出席者包括孙逸仙夫人、中央研究院院长杨杏佛（Yang Ken Vuh）、东北义勇军后援会代表陈亚夫（Chen Ah Fu）、欧亚航空公司代表胡楣（Hu Mei）、中华基督教青年会代表蔡和惠（Tsai Ho Hui）、律师公会代表吴雷（Wu Lei）以及其他四十个公共团体的代表。

主持会议的李剑华（Li Chien Hua）在阐述该会宗旨时指出，外国侵略日益加剧，民族危机日趋严重。杨杏佛和律师俞希（Yu Hsi，音译）也发表了演讲。

作为该会筹备委员会委员的孙逸仙夫人发表了长篇演说（全文刊登于今日《字林西报》），她在演说中谈到基于社会主义基础的工农业发展、废除勒索、苏联五年计划的成功以及资本主义国家危机的加深。她批评了本国的现状，并继续说道：“我们呼吁全中国的男女青年，特别是劳工、农民和义勇军，团结起来，为争取我们的解放、中国的统一与完整、中国人民的言论、出版和集会自由，以及释放所有政治犯而斗争。在全国每一个城镇和乡村，我们必须斗争并要求：(1) 至少80%的国军配备充足的武器和飞机，开赴前线抵抗日本帝国主义，收复热河，保卫中国；(2) 武装民众，组织民众自卫团；(3) 恢复言论、出版和集会等民主权利，废除对革命者的监禁、酷刑和处决”。

随后，就协会的成立及代表任命问题进行了讨论，之后通过了以下决议：
(1) 请蒋介石将军亲赴前线，指挥国军收复失地。
(2) 请国民政府立即向东北义勇军发放充足的装备。

Extract from Intelligence Report dated April 7, 1933

Praparatory Committee of the Eastern District Branch
of the People's Self Salvation Association to Resist
Insult - Meeting

Under the auspices of the abovementioned committee,
forty-nine persons claiming to represent 29 bodies in the
Eastern District held a meeting in the Kaoyu Fellow Country-
men's Association, 33 Ming Teh Li, (明德里) (Lane 120),
Sungpan Road, between 6.55 and 9.25 p.m. April 6. Li Siao-
foong (李嘯峰) claiming to represent the General Office of
the People's Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult,
presided. The following resolutions were put before the
attendance and passed :-

1. That the Government be asked to forthwith despatch all
forces and aeroplanes it possesses to the North to
to resist Japan and to restore Jehol and Manchuria
within a fixed time.

2. That the Government be asked to forthwith supply the
North-Eastern Volunteer Armies with military requirements.

3. That a fund be raised by collecting contributions among
the people for the aid of the North Eastern volunteers and
sufferers.

4. That a Liquidation Committee be organized to liquidate
accounts of funds for the aid of the North Eastern
Volunteer Armies.

5. That the people's rights (freedom in speech, publication,
assemblage and organization) be protected and that
opposition be made to the arrest, detention and tragic
killing of anti-Japanese and anti-Imperialist masses.
That all political offenders be released and that the
Law Governing the Punishment of Persons who Commit Acts
with Intent to Injure the Republic of China as well as
the Press Law be nulified from date.

6. That the Government at once issue arms to the people
who should organize "People's Self Defence Groups" and
"Volunteer Groups to Proceed to the North".

7. That the citizens of the nation organize of their own
accord "Enemy Goods Inspection Committee" with a view to
extending the boycott movement, and to donating the
proceeds of auctions of the seizures for the support of
the North Eastern Volunteer Armies.

8. That arrangements be made to welcome the Eastern
Observation Groups of the World Anti-War League and
to collect for this group material facts on the invasion
of China by the Japanese and other Imperialists.

9. That "North Eastern Volunteer Army Consolation Group"
be organized in order to send comforts collected by the
Association to the anti-Japanese volunteers at the front.

民众救国抗侮会东区分会筹备委员会 - 会议

在上述委员会的主持下，四十九名自称代表东区29个团体的人员，于4月6日晚上6时55分至9时25分，在嵩潘路明德里（120弄）33号的高榆同乡会举行会议。自称代表民众救国抗侮会总办事处的李啸峰（Li Siao-foong）主持会议。会上提出并通过以下决议：

1. 请政府立即派遣其拥有的全部部队和飞机北上抗日，并在限期内收复热河和满洲。

2. 请政府立即向东北义勇军提供军事物资。

3. 通过向民众募捐筹集资金，以援助东北义勇军和受灾群众。

4. 组织清算委员会，清理援助东北义勇军的基金账目。

5. 保护民众权利（言论、出版、集会和结社自由），反对逮捕、拘留和惨杀反日及反帝群众。释放所有政治犯，并自即日起废除《危害民国紧急治罪法》及《出版法》。

6. 请政府立即向民众发放武器，民众应组织“民众自卫团”和“北上义勇团”。

7. 全国公民应自发组织“仇货检查委员会”，以扩展抵制运动，并将没收物品拍卖所得捐赠给东北义勇军。

8. 安排欢迎世界反战同盟东方观察团，并为该团收集关于日本及其他帝国主义者侵略中国的事实材料。

9. 组织“东北义勇军慰劳团”，以便将该会募集的慰问品送往前线抗日义勇军手中。

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI COTTON MILL,
April 10, 1933.

The arrest of members of the Self Salvation
Association and the handling of the case.

At 5.50 p.m. April 7, 1933
Mr. F. Kanedo of the Workers Section of No. 4 Mill and
Mr. S. Akamatsu of the Workers Section of No. 5 Mill
at No. 19 Lay Road, noticed 8 Chinese, including one
girl, all having the appearance of students and 3 Chinese,
including one girl, delivering speeches and distributing
handbills at the gates of the Nos 4 and 5 mills on
Tsitsihar Road among the workers who were coming and
going from the mills as it was time for changing shifts.
A copy of the handbills is
attached herewith.

The handbills are of an
inflammatory nature containing untrue statements about
the Shanghai Cotton Mill with the object of instigating
the labourers to submit unreasonable demands.

At 2 p.m. the same day
Mr. Akamatsu of the Workers Section was informed by the
Workers Department at the Head Office regarding the
disturbance. He immediately informed Yulin Road Police
Station requesting the dispatch of police officers. At
the same time he maintained a close watch on their
movements.

The party of 8 Chinese then
started to move from the gate of No. 5 mill towards the
gate of No. 4 mill. Mr. Akamatsu and Mr. Kaneda
followed the party to the gate of No. 4 mill. As the
party was about to mingle with the crowd gathered at the
gate Mr. Akamatsu requested Yulin Road Police Station
page_data.zh:
上海棉纺株式会社，
1933年4月10日。

关于救国联合会成员被捕及案件处理情况。

1933年4月7日下午5时50分
位于雷路（Lay Road）19号的第四厂工务科F. Kanedo先生和第五厂工务科S. Akamatsu先生注意到，在齐齐哈尔路第四和第五厂门口，有8名中国人（包括一名女孩），均具学生模样，另有3名中国人（包括一名女孩），正在向上下班换班的工人发表演讲并散发传单。传单副本附后。

该传单具有煽动性，包含有关上海棉纺株式会社的不实陈述，旨在煽动劳工提出不合理要求。

同日下午2时
工务科的Akamatsu先生接到总办事处工务部关于此次骚乱的通知。他立即通知榆林路巡捕房，请求派遣警员。同时，他密切监视他们的行动。

这伙8名中国人随后开始从第五厂门口向第四厂门口移动。Akamatsu先生和Kanedo先生跟随这伙人至第四厂门口。当这伙人即将混入聚集在门口的人群中时，Akamatsu先生请求榆林路巡捕房

page_data.en:
-2-
accompanied by a Sikh constable, arrived on the scene
in a motor car. The police officers, with the
assistance of the mill employees, succeeded in
arresting 4 Chinese, including one girl. The officers
took the prisoners together with two Japanese witnesses
named S. Yamaguchi and Nakano to Yulin Road Station.
The witnesses were not questioned.
On the following day, the Shanghai
Cotton Mill sent Secretary Kageyama to Yulin Road Police
Station to inquire about the case. He was told that
the 4 prisoners had been released the previous evening.
He secured an interview with
Detective Gibson and Mr. Isaac, acting officer in
charge of the Police Station, in the presence of Sub-
Inspector Hanafuji and Detective Ueoka and asked them
to give an explanation of the release of the prisoners.
At first, the two officers
explained that the prisoners were released for the
following reasons:- That the contents of the handbills
were not inflammatory, that the case was of a political
and anti-Japanese nature, that the prisoners were not
communists, and that two of the prisoners were British
subjects as they were born in Singapore.
The mill management replied as
follows:- That the contents of the handbills are
inflammatory, that the prisoners had attempted to
incigate the labourers, that they had not only made
disturbing speeches on the road but distributed
inflammatory handbills as well, that they had attempted
to incite the innocent labourers and to incite them
to go on strike.
He then requested the officials
to pay more attention to the handling of such
cases in future because the mill will not be able to
page_data.zh:
-2-
派出一名锡克族巡佐，乘汽车抵达现场。警员在厂方员工的协助下，成功逮捕了4名中国人（包括一名女孩）。警员将囚犯连同两名名为S. Yamaguchi和Nakano的日本证人带往榆林路巡捕房。证人未受讯问。
次日，上海棉纺株式会社派遣秘书Kageyama前往榆林路巡捕房查询此案。他被告知这4名囚犯已于前晚释放。
他在副督察Hanafuji和侦探Ueoka在场的情况下，得以会见侦探Gibson和代理巡捕房主管Isaac先生，并要求他们对释放囚犯一事作出解释。
起初，这两名官员解释说，释放囚犯的原因如下：传单内容不具有煽动性；该案具有政治性和反日性质；囚犯并非共产党人；且其中两名囚犯因出生于新加坡而属英国臣民。
厂方管理层答复如下：传单内容具有煽动性；囚犯曾试图煽动劳工；他们不仅在马路上发表扰乱秩序的演讲，还散发了煽动性传单；他们试图诱骗无辜劳工并煽动其罢工。
他随后要求官员们今后更加注意此类案件的处理，因为如果允许此类活动继续下去，工厂将无法

page_data.en:
-3-
conduct its business peacefully if such activities
be permitted to continue.

Finally Mr. Isaac, acting officer
in charge of the station, informed him that although
the prisoners had been released, investigations are
still being made by Headquarters; that as far as Yulin
Road Police Station was concerned the case was closed
but Headquarters would continue to deal with the matter.
Therefore, sufficient attention would still be paid to
the case.

Judging from the above statement
although the case has been taken up by Headquarters an
adequate investigation can not be made because the
prisoners have already been released. Therefore, we
hope that the Yulin Road Police Station will pay careful
attention to such cases in future and to deal in a careful
manner with people who attempt to obstruct business and
to disturb the peace and order of the International
Settlement.

We would like to know what progress
the investigation has made, how the authorities are
dealing with the case, and what policy will be adopted
in future in such cases.

Shanghai Cotton Mill,
No. 1970 Yangtzepoo Road.

Commissioner of Police,
S. M. F.
page_data.zh:
-3-
和平经营业务。

最后，代理巡捕房主管Isaac先生告知他，虽然囚犯已被释放，但总部仍在进行调查；就榆林路巡捕房而言，此案已结，但总部将继续处理此事。因此，仍将对此案给予充分关注。

鉴于上述陈述，虽然总部已接手此案，但由于囚犯已被释放，无法进行充分调查。因此，我们希望榆林路巡捕房今后能仔细关注此类案件，并以谨慎的方式处理那些企图阻碍商业活动及扰乱国际租界和平秩序的人员。

我们欲知调查进展如何，当局如何处理此案，以及今后在此类案件中将采取何种政策。

上海棉纺株式会社，
杨树浦路1970号。

警务处处长，
S. M. F.

THE NORTH-CHINA DAILY NEWS, MONDAY, APRIL 3, 1933

ACTION AGAINST
COMMUNISTS

Manifesto Issued By Mrs.
Sun Yat-sen

ANTI-IMPERIALIST
STRUGGLE URGED

A call to the masses of the Chinese people to struggle against the policy pursued by the Nanking Government is made by Mrs. Sun Yat-sen in the course of a statement issued on Saturday in connection with the extradition to the Chinese authorities in the Second District Court of five alleged Communists.

“The procedure adopted in these cases obviously exposes the fact: the Shanghai International Settlement, which the imperialists describe as an “isle of security and justice” for themselves, is also a paradise for Imperialist enemies of China, traitors and betrayers of the Chinese people, opium traffickers, and Sun.” Here now are absolute freedom and full recognition and support from representatives of Japanese imperialism that has invaded, conquered and annexed four of our provinces. Here representatives of the Nanking Government and of the armed invaders of our territory make secret and friendly calls on each other to prepare for the secret treaty that will turn our territory and millions of our people over to a foreign imperialist conqueror. While this goes on members and leaders of the Chinese revolutionary workers’ and peasants’ movement, who are struggling against the dismemberment and subjection of China, suffer imprisonment, torture and death.

Call To The Masses

“These iniquitous conditions must be brought to an end by the united, determined struggle of the broad masses of the Chinese people. They can be terminated for ever only when we take our fate in our hands, free the country from imperialists and the Chinese henchmen of imperialists, and establish our own courts and other institutions of a free people. In order to free ourselves, we must recognise the necessity of this fundamental fact, and struggle with determination. One of the first steps to this end is to fight the continued persecution and killing of revolutionary fighters who are already leading this struggle. I regard the China League for Civil Rights as one of the means to obtain our end.”

According to a statement by a spokesman of the Municipality of Greater Shanghai, another accused person, Liao Zung-tse, the son of the murdered Kuomintang leader, Liao Chung-kai, was released on security, but will have to appear whenever his presence is required. In an interview with representatives of the Chinese press, Liao is reported as saying that he returned to China from Germany only one month ago. On March 28 he went to call on a merchant to purchase tea to be sent to the troops in the north-east. On entering the house, he declared, he was immediately arrested by officers of the Public Safety Bureau and detained in Louza Police Station. He was handed over to the Public Safety Bureau on March 31, and released on security the same evening.

Vernacular papers state that on Saturday afternoon several prisoners were seen being placed on board a train ready to leave the North Station, under supervision of Public Safety Bureau officers. Whether they were being sent to Nanking or to the Kiangsu High Court at Soochow was not known.

镇压共产党人行动

孙逸仙夫人发表宣言

呼吁开展反帝斗争

孙逸仙夫人在周六就五名涉嫌共产党人被引渡至第二特区法院移交中国当局一事发表的声明中，号召中国人民大众起来反对南京政府所推行的政策。

“这些案件中所采取的程序显然暴露了这样一个事实：被帝国主义者描述为他们‘安全与正义之岛’的上海公共租界，同时也是中国的帝国主义敌人、中国人民的叛徒和卖国贼、鸦片贩子以及孙（原文如此）的天堂。在这里，他们享有绝对的自由，并得到那些入侵、征服并吞并了我们四个省份的日本帝国主义代表的充分认可和支持。在这里，南京政府的代表与我们领土上的武装入侵者代表相互进行秘密而友好的访问，旨在准备一项秘密条约，将我们的领土和数百万人民移交给外国帝国主义征服者。与此同时，那些为反对瓜分和奴役中国而斗争的中国革命工农运动的成员和领导人，却遭受监禁、酷刑和死亡。”

号召民众

“必须通过广大中国人民大众的团结和坚决斗争来终结这些不公正的状况。只有当我们掌握自己的命运，使国家摆脱帝国主义及其中国走狗的统治，并建立我们自由人民自己的法院和其他机构时，这些状况才能被永远终止。为了获得解放，我们必须认识到这一基本事实的必要性，并进行坚决的斗争。为此目的的首要步骤之一，就是反对对已经领导这场斗争的革命战士的持续迫害和杀戮。我认为中国民权保障同盟是实现我们目标的手段之一。”

据大上海市政府发言人声明，另一名被告、被杀害的国民党领导人廖仲恺之子廖宗泽（Liao Zung-tse，音译）已获保释，但须在需要其出庭时随时到庭。据报道，廖在接受中国新闻界代表采访时称，他仅在一个月前从德国返回中国。3月28日，他去拜访一位商人，购买要运往东北给部队的茶叶。他声称，一进屋便立即被公安局警员逮捕，并拘押在老闸捕房。他于3月31日被移交给公安局，并于当晚获保释。

中文报纸称，周六下午，有人看见几名囚犯在公安局警员的监管下被送上准备从北站开出的火车。至于他们是被送往南京还是苏州的江苏高等法院，则不得而知。

Subject (in full) Communistic posters finding on the wall of Sung Sing
No. 9 Cotton Hill, Yangtsepoo Road.

Made by D.F. I Gibson Forwarded by D.C.I. Shields.

Sir,
At 5 p.m. 31/3/33 D.F.I. Chang Ming Tuh and C.J.C. 161
observed a number of posters of a communistic and anti Japanese
nature posted on the walls of the Sung Sing No. 9 Cotton Hill
and vicinity. Nothing could be ascertained showing who had

forwarded to the Special Branch.

I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
J. Gibson

Afternoon Translation. 1

March 31, 1933.

MISCELLANEOUS.

China Times and other local newspapers:

RIGHTS PROTECTION LEAGUE AND POLITICAL OFFENDERS.

At a meeting held yesterday afternoon by the
China People's Rights Protection League at the Central
Research Institute, the following resolutions were passed:-

1. That 5 members including Wu Mei (a lawyer) be
detailed to investigate the treatment of political
offenders in the Settlement Jails.

2. That a letter be sent to the Control Council
requesting it to publish a detailed account of the action
taken in the case of the execution of Liu Yung-sun,
Manager and editor of the "Kiang Sun Jih Pao" at
Chingkiang, by order of General Koo Tso-dong, Chairman
of the Kiangsu Provincial Government and that officials
of the Council be requested to resign en bloc if no
action be taken on their impeachment.

D 4606

《中国时报》及其他本地报纸：

人权保障同盟与政治犯。

中国人权保障同盟昨日下午在中央研究院举行会议，通过以下决议：

1. 指派吴迈（律师）等5人组成小组，调查租界监狱内政治犯的待遇情况。

2. 致函监察院，要求其公布江苏省政府主席顾祝同将军下令处决镇江《江声日报》经理兼编辑刘煜孙一案的详细处理经过；并请求，若对该案相关官员的弹劾未获处理，则要求监察院委员集体辞职。

D 4606

March 18, 1933

Extract of the Intelligence Report
Political

People's Self Salvation Association to Resist Insultentertains
local Journalists.

The People's Self Salvation Association to Resist Insult
which was promoted by Madame Sun Yat Sen and Wu Mai, the firebrand
lawyer, and which was a communication office in the residence of
Wu Mai. 48 Route Vallon, entertained some 30 local Journalists to
tea in the Medium Club, 574 Weihaiwei Road, between 6 and 7.30 p.m.
March 17. Wu Mai, who presided, reported to the attendance that
Madame Sun Yat Sen was at Hangchow and unable to attend the meet-
ing. He then made public the aim of the Association which is to
unite the people for the unification and independence and territo-
rial integrity of China as well as to render material and moral
assistance to the anti-Japanese volunteer armies. After this, he
denounced Chang Hsueh Liang for his non-resistance policy which
led to the loss of Manchuria and Jehol. He concluded his address
by urging the overthrow of the Imperialists and the salvation of
the Nation with "our" power.

Supt. Robertson,
Re: report submitted this am.
re the proposed meeting to be held
in the Tzuyui Primary School, Dah
Chen li ( ) Of Yulin Rd, at 1 pm on
April 2, I am informed that the above
mentioned organization is behind the
project. According to an unconfirmed
report a meeting of the association
will be held in the said school tomorrow
i.e. on Friday (April 1):

J. L.

情报报告摘录
政治类

“民众御侮自救会”招待本地记者。

“民众御侮自救会”由孙逸仙夫人及激进派律师吴迈发起，其通讯处设于吴迈寓所（法租界华伦路48号）。该会于3月17日下午6时至7时30分，在威海卫路574号中西女塾俱乐部（Medium Club）设茶点招待约30名本地记者。会议由吴迈主持，他向与会者报告称，孙逸仙夫人正在杭州，无法出席此次会议。随后，他公开了该会的宗旨，即团结民众，以实现中国的统一、独立及领土完整，并为抗日义勇军提供物质和精神援助。此后，他谴责张学良采取不抵抗政策，导致满洲和热河沦丧。他在演讲结束时呼吁依靠“我们”的力量推翻帝国主义，拯救国家。

罗伯逊警司，
关于：今晨提交的报告，
涉及拟于4月2日下午1时
在榆林路达臣里（ ）慈裕小学
举行的会议。据告知，上述
组织是此次活动的幕后推手。
据一则未经证实的消息称，
该协会将于明日，即4月1日
（星期五），在该校举行会议：

J. L.
4月3日
